records.title: Web profile: dsh-tool-web (web_fetch) disabled by default -> agents fall back to bash+curl with default UA and get blocked by WAF/CDN
records.body:
**Web profile: `dsh-tool-web` (web_fetch) is disabled by default → agents fall back to `bash`+`curl` with a fingerprintable default UA and get blocked by WAF/CDN**

In a real session on the `web` profile, asking the agent to fetch a web page produced this chain:

1. `web_search` (deepseek-official provider) fails — `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is not set. Configuring API keys on the user side is understood to be the design; the problem is what happens *after* that failure.
2. `web_fetch` is **not in the agent's tool list at all** — even though the tool exists in the codebase.
3. The agent falls back to the `bash` tool and runs `curl https://...` directly → default `curl/x.x` User-Agent, no browser fingerprint → the request is **blocked by WAF** (reproduced on Baidu's search page) → the agent then improvised UA spoofing with `-A "Mozilla/5.0 ... Chrome/125..."` (fragile), and repeated blocked requests risk **IP bans**.

The effective web-profile config shows why:

```yaml
- id: tool-web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
  config:
    fetch: false
  disabled: true
```

**Requests:**

1. **Enable `web_fetch` by default in the web profile.** Plain HTTP fetch does not need an API key — it runs through the local `ctx.web` fetch provider. If it is intentionally off by default, please document the override in the README; right now the only way to find it is dumping the config:
   ```yaml
   # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
   - id: tool-web
     enabled: true
     config:
       fetch: true
   ```
2. **Make the fetch User-Agent configurable** (and default to something less fingerprintable). This is a product-quality ask, not an anti-bot one: an obviously non-browser UA is exactly what gets requests blocked and IPs banned on WAF/CDN-fronted sites.
3. **When web tools are unavailable (search key missing / fetch disabled), surface it in the runtime context or UI** instead of leaving the agent to silently fall back to `bash`+`curl` with default headers.

Happy to provide the config/UX details if useful.

comments.body:
这个场景可以先用现成 Pi Web 工具把“没有 `web_fetch` → 模型退化到 bash + curl”这条链拆掉，而且现在安装不需要写 Cordis overlay：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
dsh plugin --profile web add @juicesharp/rpiv-web-tools
```

装完重启后会向 DSH 注册 `web_search` 和 `web_fetch` 两个正常工具。搜索可选多种后端；例如自建 SearXNG：

```sh
export WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=searxng
export SEARXNG_URL=https://your-searxng.example.com
```

这条路径已经做过真实运行验证：`web_search` 经 SearXNG 返回结果，`web_fetch` 直接抓取公开 HTTPS 页面，而不是让 agent 临时拼 `curl`。桥接项目是 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh)，Pi 包保持原样运行。

它不能保证绕过所有站点的 WAF，但能直接补上原帖缺失的正式 fetch/search 工具，并避免因为工具不存在而自动滑向默认 UA 的裸 `curl`。

records.title: [Feat Request] : When  inputModalities excludes Image , If `AllowImageInputWhenUnsupported` settings , justa pass it.
records.body:
## Background

Currently,When GUI input box sends a picture，if current model calims its  `inputModalities` exclude `image`（e.g. ds v4p），request would be reject forcibly ,and render warnning as follow:

![image-20260814080124473](https://ali-oss-yceachan.oss-cn-chengdu.aliyuncs.com/img-bed-typora/image-20260814080124473.png)

Code Locates：`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` 的 `prompt` 处理器：

```ts
if (modelInfo.inputModalities !== undefined && !modelInfo.inputModalities.includes('image')) {
  return err(request, {
    code: 'attachment-error',
    details: { reason: 'MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES' },
  })
}
```

## Feat Request

I Hoped that  adds a extra `vision_hepler_check` path,and user could config a setteing `"AllowImageInputWhenUnsupported: true`.

If thats is set,just pass  it,and llm would spawn its Customized Vision-understanding workflow.

comments.body:
感谢提出这个方向。补充一个关键点：**单靠"放行"并不够**——图片进入会话后，下一跳 `agent/request` 仍会按当前（纯文本）模型构建请求，把图片直接发给不声明 image 输入的模型，请求依然会失败。

完整闭环应该是**准入放行 + 请求层 vision fallback** 两段配合：

1. **准入层**（本讨论提议的开关）：`AllowImageInputWhenUnsupported: true` 时，`prompt` 准入不再以 `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` 拒绝图片（`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts`），让图片进入会话历史；
2. **请求层**：`agent/request` 瀑布（`dsh-agent`）已支持按请求替换 provider/model——已有第三方插件（如 dsh-toolbelt 的 `vision-fallback`，hook 在 `agent/request`）在"派生消息含图 + 当前模型不声明 image"时，把这一次请求路由到已注册的视觉模型（先按候选列表，再 `scanRegisteredModels` 兜底扫描所有 provider 目录中声明 image 的模型）。harness 不必自己实现路由，只需放行 + 保留 `resolveModelInfo` 能力查询即可。

两个补充观察：

- **不止一处准入闸**：`api-proxy.ts` 里除 `prompt` 的 `hasImage` 检查外，还有一处"会话历史已含图 + 模型不支持 → `model-unavailable`"的检查（fork/续接场景）。若开关只放开 `prompt` 路径，会话中途切到纯文本模型后继续/fork 的场景仍会被拦截，建议两处一起处理。
- **请求层 fallback 与准入开关是互补的**：即使不开准入开关，历史图片（先用了视觉模型、后切纯文本模型）在后续请求中仍会被请求层 fallback 兜底路由。这也是 `agent/request` 瀑布相对准入检查的优势所在，值得在设计中一起考虑。

本机已验证的用例：主模型 `deepseek-v4-flash`（显式 `inputModalities: ["text"]`）+ 视觉模型经已注册 provider 提供；`vision-fallback` 能找到视觉路由时，图片请求自动切到视觉模型，纯文本请求留在原模型，无需任何全局状态。

replies.body:
感谢参与讨论，你的vision fallback的设计的不错。
但我的issue是，透明路由一轮消息到视觉模型的设计会导致成本飙升，完整的工程上下文被全量fork给一个无读缓的新模型，代价很大。
我的设想是，做一个vision_helper 的 tool call，在provider model list 里存在视觉模型时启用，让主模型自发地通过tool call 来委托fresh context 的 vision subagent完成视觉理解。

补充一种方案：纯插件、零核心补丁，[repo](https://github.com/yuqingsh/dsh-image-subagent) 。

机制：准入放行 + 占位符 + 视觉子代理原生读图

1. 准入层：经 cordis internal/get 瀑布包装 llm 服务的 resolveModelInfo，对未声明 image 的路由补报 image 能力——贴图不再被 MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES 拒绝（listModels 保持真实，不误导模型选择器）。
2. 占位符：包装 prepareCall/stream 为惰性生成器，克隆（deepFreeze 的）request 后把 image 块投影为显式占位文本（含 attachmentId），纯文本适配器不再抛 UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT，整轮正常完成。
3. 委托：主模型保持推理角色，把读图交给同会话多模态子代理——子代理经 read_attachment 原生读取持久化附件，**不做「先压缩成文本描述再转述」的语义损耗**，支持多轮追问。

已在0.1.0-rc.6 上端到端验证。

comments.body:
这个场景现在可以用 pi2dsh 的视觉伴生路由完整解决，不只是把图片“硬放行”给不支持图片的模型。

安装：

    dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0
    dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision

配置一个公开可用的视觉模型：

    export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
    export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
    export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY

装好后会为原文本模型生成一个伴生的 <route>-vision 路由。Web 里直接粘贴图片时，伴生路由先允许图片进入，由 @kassing/pi-vision 完成识图并把结果注入上下文，然后在调用原文本适配器前移除 image blocks，所以不会再被 inputModalities 校验拦住，也不会把不支持的图片块继续传给文本模型。

这条链路已经在真实 DSH Web 会话里做过端到端验证：粘贴测试图，视觉插件注入分析，原 DeepSeek 文本路由零图像输入给出正确答案。插件和 DSH 源码都不需要修改。

示例和配置：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge

感谢各位集思广益的讨论，再补充一个在社区看到的方案 bundle plugin [ysr666/dsh-vision-router](https://github.com/ysr666/dsh-vision-router)  @ysr666
以下为个人整理的机制分析汇总：
## 官方Profile Web api-proxy image 拦截机制

Web GUI 粘贴图片时，官方链路在**三处独立的地方**可能把含图请求拦下。只有把它们**同时**打通，图片轮才算真正能用：

| #                       | 检查                                                         | 官方位置 / 逻辑                                            | 失败表现                                                     | 放在哪一层能解 |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- |
| ① 准入闸 **Gate 1**     | api-proxy `prompt` 里 `hasImage → resolveModelInfo(inputModalities)`（`api-proxy.ts:2482-2494`） | 当前选中模型不含 `image` → `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` | **模型目录层**：让"当前选中模型"在 `resolveModelInfo` 眼里声明 image |                |
| ② 反向准入闸 **Gate 2** | api-proxy `selectModel`（`api-proxy.ts:2286-2306`）          | 会话历史已含图、目标模型不含 image → `model-unavailable`   | 同①；再配合把历史图改写掉                                    |                |
| ③ 请求层兜底            | deepseek 适配器 `assertTextOnly`（`llm-deepseek/serialize.ts:64-68`） | 文本适配器**硬拒**任何 image block → `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT` | **模型输入层**：进适配器前把 image block 改写成文本          |                |

---

## 构造声明有vision能力的模型路由，注册Vision工具。

[ysr666/dsh-vision-router](https://github.com/ysr666/dsh-vision-router) 的答案可以压缩成三句话，对应三处独立的作用点：

1. **准入放行** —— 在 **模型目录层** 制造"声明了 image 的模型条目"：新增路由时就声明 image（**绕过检测**）；接管官方路由时由插件重建的 adapter 声明 image（**替换 adapter**）。
2. **Message改写** —— 在 **模型输入层** 把 image block 改写成文本/tool 提示，让文本适配器（deepseek 等）**永远看不到图**，从而绕开 ③ 的硬拒；UI/会话日志仍保留原图。
3. **注册Vision工具** —— 图片不靠"一次性描述"而是通过 **11 个普通工具调用**（`vision_describe`/`vision_ground`/…）被读取，主模型始终是大脑、视觉模型只当临时眼睛。

records.title: ACP: support session-scoped stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP servers
records.body:
## Problem

ACP `session/new` carries `mcpServers`, but the current bridge rejects every non-empty list. An ACP client therefore cannot attach session-specific tools even though DeepSeek Harness already has a supervised MCP client plugin.

## Proposed integration

Translate ACP declarations into `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` configuration:

- stdio: `command`, `args`, environment, and session `cwd`
- HTTP: Streamable HTTP URL and headers
- reject SSE and ACP-carried MCP with explicit invalid-params errors until matching transport providers exist
- advertise `mcpCapabilities.http: true`
- wait for initial connection and tool discovery before `session/new` returns
- dispose the just-created agent if MCP startup fails

Each MCP client is mounted through the exact `agent.ctx`, so tools and teardown remain session scoped. Independent sessions can reuse the same client-declared `serverName` without changing the public `mcp__<server>__<tool>` names.

## Async registration seam

Tool discovery completes asynchronously. To prevent delayed registration from silently falling back to the global layer, the prototype lets `ToolRuntime.register` accept an explicit preserved registration context. The MCP supervisor captures and uses it for initial discovery and later re-sync/reconnect generations. Namespace reservations use the same explicit owner boundary.

Startup failures include the concrete underlying connection or tool-registration cause rather than only a generic wrapper.

## Validation

A local independent commit (`70149e184d`) is based on current `master` (`47f943859b`). Tests cover two simultaneous ACP sessions using the same real stdio MCP fixture, unsupported transport rejection, HTTP startup rollback, reconnect/client lifecycle regressions, and ToolRuntime regressions. Results: 540 focused tests pass; ACP source coverage is 100% statements/branches/functions/lines; package typecheck and the 28/28 doc-sync gate pass. I can provide the patch in the maintainers preferred format.

records.title: 源码启动的情况下怎么把别人做的plugin加入呢
records.body: 源码启动的情况下怎么把别人做的plugin加入呢

comments.body:
源码 checkout 下把 `dsh ...` 换成 `pnpm dsh ...` 就行，其余完全一样——
`docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md:7` 明确写了这一点，机制见
`apps/cli/reference/README.md:97`（`package.json` 的 `dsh` 脚本以
`node --import tsx/esm` 直接跑 `apps/cli/src/bin.ts`）。

**装别人发布的插件：**

```sh
pnpm run build                                        # 源码首次/产物过期时需要
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add <包名或本地路径>
```

`dsh plugin` 是 pnpm 的薄转发层——`apps/cli/src/plugin.ts:120-133`：先 `initProfile`（profile 不存在
时），再在 profile 目录里 `spawnSync('pnpm', args)`，最后 `reconcilePlugins`。所以 pnpm 的所有
写法都能用：`add ./my-plugin`、`add ./x.tgz`、`add github:you/x`、`remove`、`why`。

相对路径是安全的：`anchorPathSpec`（`apps/cli/src/plugin.ts:104-113`）会把 `.` / `../plugin`
重写成相对**你敲命令的目录**的绝对路径——否则 pnpm 的 cwd 是 profile 目录，`add .` 会把 profile
自己链进去。

**一个容易踩空的地方：** 装上不等于生效。只有 manifest 里声明了
`"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }` 的包才会进层叠栈；否则它只是个普通依赖，
并且只警告一次——`apps/cli/src/plugin.ts:72`：

```
dsh: warning: <pkg> declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer
```

这种包需要你自己在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里写一行 `insert` 把它挂上。
装完用 `pnpm dsh web --dump-config` 确认它真的在组合后的树里。

**如果是要跑自己没打包的本地插件**，不用装，直接用 `--patch` 覆盖层，注意插件路径必须是绝对路径
——`docs/user/develop/basic/index.md:50-62`：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: hello
      name: '/absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness/scratch-plugin/src/my-plugin.ts'
```

```sh
pnpm dsh web --patch ./scratch-plugin/cordis.yml
```

文档原话：「A patch file contributes configuration but does not change the profile directory from
which the loader resolves module paths.」（`index.md:56`）——所以 patch 里的相对路径不会按 patch
文件所在目录解析。

# DSH 接入 OpenCode Go 的 DeepSeek V4：正确配置与排障（404 / "API key is invalid"）

> 环境：Windows · dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` · 凭据存于 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` · 配置存于 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`

## 背景

OpenCode Go（opencode.ai 的订阅套餐，按工作区订阅）提供 `deepseek-v4-pro` / `deepseek-v4-flash` 等模型。我想在 DSH 里直接把它们作为默认模型，结果踩了一串坑。最终一行配置解决。

## 三个典型报错（按出现顺序）

### 1. "API key is invalid"

- **现象**：会话请求失败，GUI 显示 `API key is invalid`。
- **真相**：这是 DSH 对失败记录 `code === "AUTH"` 的统一翻译，只代表请求在鉴权环节被拒。原因可能是 key 无效，也可能是**请求打错了端点**（baseURL 配成网页地址时，网关在错误路径返回 401/404）。

### 2. 返回 opencode 官网的 404 页面

- **根因**：`baseURL` 被填成了 `https://opencode.ai/workspace/wrk_.../keys` —— 这是 **API Keys 管理页面**，不是 API 端点。pi-ai 会在 baseURL 后拼 `/chat/completions`，于是请求打到网页路径 → 官网 404。
- **正确端点**：`https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`（OpenAI 兼容）。

### 3. apiKeyEnv 引用对不上凭据文件

- **现象**：写成 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，但凭据文件里只有 `OPENCODE_API_KEY`，解析不到。
- **真相**：pi-ai 内置目录里 opencode-go 的默认凭据引用就是 **`OPENCODE_API_KEY`**，别自创名字。

## 正确配置：一行就行

pi-ai 内置目录**原生支持 opencode-go**（"OpenCode Zen Go"）：端点 `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`、24 个模型（网关实际 26 个）、`deepseek-v4-pro/flash` 在 `openai-completions` 协议下且自带 `thinkingFormat: deepseek`。

所以**不要手写 baseURL / api / models 列表**（会覆盖内置目录、丢失 thinking 格式等细节），用最小化目录覆盖：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/settings.yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode-go:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY
```

默认模型切到 opencode-go：

```yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: opencode-go
  model: deepseek-v4-pro
  reasoningEffort: high
```

凭据（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`）：

```yaml
OPENCODE_API_KEY: "sk-你在opencode.ai/auth生成的key"
```

> 注意：Go 订阅与**工作区**绑定（"Only one member per workspace can subscribe to OpenCode Go"）。key 必须在**订阅了 Go 的工作区**生成，否则会报 "Insufficient balance"。

## 验证（Windows 上用 node，避开 curl 的 SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS）

列模型（验证 key）：

```bash
node -e "const https=require('node:https');const req=https.request({hostname:'opencode.ai',path:'/zen/go/v1/models',method:'GET',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer sk-你的key'}},res=>{let b='';res.on('data',c=>b+=c);res.on('end',()=>{console.log('HTTP '+res.statusCode);console.log(b.slice(0,200));})});req.on('error',e=>console.log('ERR: '+e.message));req.end();"
```

最小对话（验证真能生成）：

```bash
node -e "const https=require('node:https');const body=JSON.stringify({model:'deepseek-v4-pro',max_tokens:16,messages:[{role:'user',content:'Reply with exactly: OK'}]});const b=Buffer.from(body);const req=https.request({hostname:'opencode.ai',path:'/zen/go/v1/chat/completions',method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer sk-你的key','Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':b.length}},res=>{let d='';res.on('data',c=>d+=c);res.on('end',()=>{console.log('HTTP '+res.statusCode);console.log(d.slice(0,300));})});req.write(b);req.end();"
```

改完配置后**刷新 DSH 页面**（支持热加载；模型列表没出现就重启 DSH）。默认模型切换只对**新会话**生效。

---

*26 个模型的逐个实测结果和踩坑清单见另一帖。*

records.title: 【BUG反馈】pi-ai DeepSeek 路由在回传跨 provider 历史消息时丢失 reasoning_content
records.body:
# Bug Report: pi-ai DeepSeek 路由在回传跨 provider 历史消息时丢失 reasoning_content，后端返回 400

> 本文档是完整的 bug 上报材料
> 附带的修复代码已在本机验证通过（单测 + wire 级测试）。

## 1. 环境

- deepseek-harness（本仓库），`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 适配器
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.82.1（`dist/api/transform-messages.js`）
- 网关：nginx/1.24.0 反代到 DeepSeek thinking 模式（OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容）后端，模型 `deepseek-v4-flash`
- 会话历史中混有由 `deepseek-official`（`dsh-llm-deepseek` 适配器）产生的 assistant 消息（带 reasoning 内容块）

## 2. 症状

- 通过 pi-ai `deepseek` 路由发消息，harness 侧报 `TRANSPORT "Connection error."`（约 330ms、0 token）
- nginx access.log：`POST /deepseek/chat/completions → 400 0`（空响应体）
- 手动用最小请求（同 endpoint、同 model、同 key、无历史）直接 curl：**200 正常返回**；服务端本身没有问题
- 一个带工具往返消息结构的最小请求（assistant 含 `tool_calls`、无 `reasoning_content`）复现 400，后端错误体：

```json
{"error":{"message":"The `reasoning_content` in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API.","type":"invalid_request_error","param":null,"code":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

## 3. 根因（两层）

### 3.1 harness 侧：`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts` 的 `foreignAssistant`

把 harness 的 `reasoning` 内容块转成 pi-ai `thinking` 块时**没有携带 `thinkingSignature`**：

```ts
case 'reasoning': content.push({ type: 'thinking', thinking: block.text }); break
```

pi-ai 只有在 thinking 块带 `thinkingSignature` 时才会在 OpenAI Chat Completions 线上发出 `reasoning_content`（`dist/api/openai-completions.js` 第 869-875 行）。

### 3.2 pi-ai 侧：`dist/api/transform-messages.js` 的 `transformMessages`

对**跨模型（foreign）** assistant 消息，thinking 块一律被转成普通文本并入 `content`（第 87-90 行）：

```js
if (isSameModel) return block;
return { type: "text", text: block.thinking };   // foreign: thinking → 文本
```

于是线上 assistant 消息变成 `content: "思考+回复文本"`、`reasoning_content` 缺失；随后 `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages` 兜底（openai-completions.js 第 924-928 行）只补**空字符串** `reasoning_content: ""`，DeepSeek thinking 模式后端拒绝空值 → 400。

> 同一模型重放（deepseek → deepseek）不受影响：`transformMessages` 对 `isSameModel` 保留 thinking 块，序列化正常发出 `reasoning_content`。问题只在**跨 provider 历史**（如本会话里 deepseek-official 的旧消息进入 pi-ai deepseek 路由）时触发——即 `LlmRuntime.forAdapter` 剥离 replayState 后走 `foreignAssistant` 的消息。

## 4. 证据

六变体对照探测（同 endpoint/model/key，逐项隔离差异，三次一致）：

| 变体 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| baseline（最小「你好」，非流式） | 200 ✅ |
| streaming（`stream: true`） | 200 ✅ |
| reasoning-effort（`reasoning_effort: high`） | 200 ✅ |
| tools（一个工具 schema） | 200 ✅ |
| large-body（~1MB） | 200 ✅（请求被接受，仅响应读取超时） |
| **tool-roundtrip（assistant 带 tool_calls、无 reasoning_content）** | **400 ❌（`reasoning_content` 必须回传）** |

harness 请求消息统计（439 条）：192 条 assistant 消息中 **110 条同时含 reasoning 块与 tool-call 块**，全部来自跨 provider 历史。

## 5. 修复（已实现并验证）

### 5.1 harness：`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts`

`foreignAssistant` 的 reasoning 分支：

```ts
case 'reasoning': content.push({
  type: 'thinking',
  thinking: block.text,
  // 默认 OpenAI-completions 标准字段名，pi-ai 据此发出 reasoning_content
  thinkingSignature: 'reasoning_content',
}); break
```

`replayedAssistant` 的 reasoning 分支：replay 未记录字段名时同样默认：

```ts
...replay.type === 'reasoning'
  ? { thinkingSignature: replay.thinkingSignature ?? 'reasoning_content' }
  : {},
```

### 5.2 pi-ai：`dist/api/transform-messages.js`（上游对应 `src/api/transform-messages.ts`）

foreign thinking 块带 signature 且目标模型要求回传 reasoning_content 时保留块，不再转文本：

```js
if (model.compat?.requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages && block.thinkingSignature) {
  return block;
}
return { type: "text", text: block.thinking };
```

### 5.3 测试

- `tests/convert.spec.ts`：更新两处 thinking 块断言（`thinkingSignature: 'reasoning_content'`）
- `tests/adapter.spec.ts`：新增 wire 级测试 `passes foreign assistant reasoning back as reasoning_content on the wire`，断言真实请求体 `messages[0]` 为 `{ role: 'assistant', content: 'answer', reasoning_content: 'think hard' }`
- 结果：`convert.spec.ts`（68）+ `adapter.spec.ts`（46）全部通过

## 6. 复现步骤

1. 配置 pi-ai `deepseek` 路由（OpenAI-completions、DeepSeek thinking 模式后端）
2. 用另一适配器（如 `deepseek-official`）产生带 reasoning 的 assistant 历史
3. 同一会话切到 pi-ai deepseek 路由发消息 → `TRANSPORT "Connection error."`；网关侧 400，后端报 `reasoning_content` 必须回传

records.title: GPT-5.6-sol: optional tool parameters are exposed as required (file writes fail)
records.body:
## Summary

GPT-5.6-sol via `openai-codex-responses` treats **optional** tool parameters as **required**, so every `write`/`bash` call must submit `sandbox_permissions` and `justification`, which then fail validation. See root cause below.

## Dependency-level tracker

https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/8105

comments.body: Dependency-level tracker created upstream: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/8105

Verified on GPT-5.6-sol after switching the session's tool presentation from native function calling to PTC / Code Mode: file creation and writing now succeed.

Isolation evidence: the filesystem backend, sandbox policy, canonical tool runtime, and the `write` executor are all functional. The failure is confined to the native function-tool schema/calling path, where optional parameters (`sandbox_permissions`, `justification`, etc.) are emitted as if required.

Why the workaround works: in Code Mode the model sees only the outer `run_code` tool, whose two parameters (`code`, `description`) are genuinely required; nested `write`/`bash` calls are dispatched internally against the canonical schemas.

Workaround: use PTC / Code Mode for GPT-5.6-sol until native optional-parameter handling is fixed.

This is a workaround and diagnostic signal, not the root fix, and sandbox escalation validation (`validateEscalationArgs`) should not be relaxed.

Dependency-level tracker: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/8105

补充一组绕过 DSH 的直接边界探针，以及对当前根因描述的修正。

## 结论摘要

当前 Discussion 和关联的 `earendil-works/pi#8105` 将现象描述为 optional 参数在 Codex 工具路径中“表现为 required”。这个用户侧描述是准确的，但进一步隔离后发现：

1. DSH 的 canonical tool schema 确实只把真正必填的字段放入 `required`；
2. DSH 的 pi-ai / Anthropic Messages 路径保留了该 `required` 数组；
3. CC Switch 3.19.2 的 Anthropic → Responses 转换也没有扩充 `required`；
4. 但 GPT/Codex 会为 Schema 中声明、却不在 `required` 中的属性主动生成类型合法的默认值。

因此，更准确的直接触发因素不是“DSH 把 optional 标成 required”，而是：

> Codex 工具调用会 materialize 所有已声明的顶层属性；DSH 又把 escalation 字段的“存在”解释为真实升级请求。

## 直接探针

我绕过 DSH，直接向本机 CC Switch 的 Anthropic Messages 入口发送了以下工具 Schema：

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "required_value": { "type": "string" },
    "optional_text": { "type": "string" },
    "optional_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["alpha", "beta"]
    }
  },
  "required": ["required_value"]
}
```

Prompt 明确要求：

```text
Call the probe tool once with required_value set to ok.
Do not invent optional values.
```

链路为：

```text
Anthropic Messages
  → CC Switch 3.19.2
  → apiFormat=openai_responses
  → Codex OAuth
  → https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses
  → gpt-5.6-sol
```

最终返回：

```json
{
  "required_value": "ok",
  "optional_text": "",
  "optional_mode": "alpha"
}
```

即 optional string 被填成 `""`，optional enum 被填成第一个 enum 值。这与 DSH 中观察到的行为完全对应：

```json
{
  "sandbox_permissions": "workspace-write",
  "justification": ""
}
```

## Nullable 对照实验

将两个 optional 字段改成：

```json
{
  "optional_text": {
    "oneOf": [{ "type": "string" }, { "type": "null" }]
  },
  "optional_mode": {
    "oneOf": [
      { "type": "string", "enum": ["alpha", "beta"] },
      { "type": "null" }
    ]
  }
}
```

同一路由返回：

```json
{
  "required_value": "ok",
  "optional_text": null,
  "optional_mode": null
}
```

这证明 nullable 能让当前 Codex 路径表达“未提供”，但 DSH 当前的 escalation 参数只接受 string，因此仍需要一侧做归一化。

## 与 `pi#8105` 的关系

`pi#8105` 将问题定位到 `openai-codex-responses` 的 `strict: null`。本次复现使用的是：

```text
DSH pi-ai anthropic-messages
  → CC Switch Anthropic endpoint
  → CC Switch 自己转换为 Codex Responses
```

因此没有经过 pi-ai 的 `openai-codex-responses` 请求适配器，但仍复现相同的 optional materialization。这表明 `strict: null` 可能是某条路径上的触发或放大因素，但不是此行为唯一成立的必要条件。更广义的问题是 Codex Responses 工具调用与 Anthropic optional-property 语义之间的兼容。

CC Switch 侧的兼容性报告：

https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6473

## 对 DSH 的建议

CC Switch 作为协议桥，可以通过 optional → nullable、返回时 null → omission 来保持 Anthropic 语义。同时，DSH 仍可以做独立 hardening，避免控制型 optional 字段被模型自动补值后阻塞普通调用。

### 最小兼容修复

对 `sandbox_permissions` 和 `justification` 允许显式 `null`，并在进入 escalation 校验前将 `null` 归一化为“未提供”。涉及：

```text
packages/shell/tool-bash
packages/shell/tool-pwsh
packages/fs/tool-fs
packages/fs/tool-fs/src/sandbox
```

### 非扩权 no-op

在解析 standing policy 后，如果模型提供的已知目标等于或窄于当前有效模式，可以考虑将这对字段视为冗余 metadata：

```text
danger-full-access + requested workspace-write
danger-full-access + requested danger-full-access
workspace-write + requested workspace-write
```

这些情况不授予任何新能力，也不应触发 approval。真正变宽的请求仍必须保持现有流程：

```text
read-only → workspace-write
read-only → danger-full-access
workspace-write → danger-full-access
```

不得削弱 strictly-wider 校验、非空 justification、approval 或 `never` 下的 fail-closed 行为。这一方向也与 #1292、#468 和 #1201 的建议一致。

### 更稳健的长期方案

不要仅凭模型提供了 `sandbox_permissions` 就认定它是一次合法升级重试。可以考虑：

1. 普通调用先发生真实 sandbox denial；
2. denial 返回一次性 `escalation_token`；
3. 只有携带该 token 的精确重试才能请求更宽模式；
4. 没有有效 token 的冗余 escalation 参数不进入审批路径；
5. 或把普通工具与 escalation retry 拆成两个独立工具。

## 建议回归测试

为 bash、pwsh、write 和 edit 增加共同测试：

1. `danger-full-access + approval never + escalation fields = null`：普通操作成功，不触发 approval。
2. `danger-full-access + workspace-write + empty justification`：若采纳 no-op 方案，按当前 standing policy 执行，不触发 approval。
3. `workspace-write + danger-full-access + valid justification`：仍要求 approval。
4. `workspace-write + danger-full-access + approval never`：仍 fail closed。
5. 未知 mode、字段只出现一半，以及真正 widening 时空 justification：仍严格拒绝。
6. 能正常省略 optional 字段的 provider：行为保持不变。

在 gpt-5.6-sol + ChatGPT Codex OAuth Responses 这条具体路由上，Codex 会对 schema 中声明但不在 required 里的顶层 optional 属性生成类型合法的非空默认值（观察为 string→""、enum→首个枚举值）。DSH 把 sandbox_permissions + justification 的成对存在解释为升级请求，因此普通调用被卡住。strict:null 不是该路由的必要条件；pi-ai 原生 codex 路径上的 strict:null 仍可能另有独立影响。

感谢补充这组直接边界探针和 nullable 对照实验——这比仅仅观察 DSH 内部现象更有说服力。

我们同意修正措辞：DSH 的 canonical tool schema 确实只把真正必填的字段放进 `required`，问题不是“DSH 把 optional 标成了 required”，而是 Codex 会对已声明但不在 `required` 里的顶层 optional 属性主动 materialize 类型合法的默认值（observed：string→`""`、enum→首个枚举值），而 DSH 又把 escalation 字段的“存在”解释为真实升级请求。

你的复现链路（DSH pi-ai anthropic-messages → CC Switch 3.19.2 → Codex Responses）没有经过 pi-ai 的 `openai-codex-responses` 适配器，因此也证明 `strict: null` 不是该行为成立的必要条件；但它在 pi-ai 原生 codex 路径上是否另有独立影响，仍需一组直接 A/B 才能定论。

接下来我们会：
1. 更正 `earendil-works/pi#8105` 的标题与因果措辞（不再把 `strict: null` 当作唯一根因）；
2. 保留 PTC/Code Mode 仅作为临时 workaround，不作为根修复；
3. 在 DSH 侧评估独立的 escalation hardening——优先试验 escalation 字段接受 nullable（`string | null`），并在进入 escalation 校验前把 `null` 归一化为“未提供”，同时完整保留成对校验、strictly-wider、approval 与 fail-closed 语义。

在归因到 `strict` 之前，仍需在 pi-ai 原生 codex 路径上做直接 A/B（`strict: null` / `false` / 省略，以及 nullable schema）。感谢澄清。

records.title: Does anybody also encounter "Output token limit reached" error while using dsh?

comments.body: I met same issue.

I checked the current dsh flow, and this looks different from a context-window overflow.

`dsh-agent-loop` treats a `max-tokens` finish as a completed model request, while automatic compaction is primarily triggered by token pressure before a step or by a provider-confirmed context-window overflow. So hitting the output cap does not necessarily trigger compaction/recovery automatically.

For the built-in DeepSeek adapter, the current default conversation `maxTokens` is 256,000, and it can be overridden by the adapter config, a model-specific cap, or an explicit agent/request value. The adapter also intentionally doesn't clamp that value against the context window.

If you're seeing this regularly, could you share:

* which provider/model you're using,
* whether you're using the default `llm-deepseek` adapter or `llm-pi-ai`,
* and the effective `maxTokens` configuration?

That would help distinguish an intentionally configured output cap from the model actually exhausting its available generation budget. If the expectation is that dsh should automatically resume after a `max-tokens` finish, that looks like a separate agent-loop behavior/feature rather than the existing compaction path.

replies.body: @bevinkatti Hi I'm currently using qwen3.8 27b running on ollama server and the adapter is llm-pi-ai. The max-token configuration I have set is 8192.

comments.body: I have the same issue

Thanks, that helps narrow it down. With `qwen3.2:7b` running through Ollama and `llm-pi-ai` configured with `max-token = 8192`, the message is consistent with the generation hitting the configured output limit rather than dsh losing the connection.

Before increasing it, could you check whether the Ollama response reports `done_reason: "length"` when this happens? That would confirm the response is being terminated by the generation limit.

If it does, the next thing I'd check is whether `llm-pi-ai` is forwarding the configured `max-token` value directly to Ollama. If it is, then 8192 is simply the effective generation ceiling for that request.

If you can paste the relevant Ollama/dsh debug output for one occurrence (with any API keys removed), we can determine whether the limit is coming from dsh, the Pi adapter, or Ollama itself.
@adwaithadwaith

Same problem running Qwen 3.8 27b

This is after a 1hour 30minute run, I end up with only 320 tokens headroom, but the prompt should be nowhere close to 65K tokens

2026-08-19 22:33:18 [DEBUG]
 I slot print_timing: id  3 | task 0 | prompt eval time =   61628.73 ms / 65216 tokens (    0.94 ms per token,  1058.21 tokens per second)
1.39.732.171 I slot print_timing: id  3 | task 0 |        eval time =   31574.96 ms /   320 tokens (   98.67 ms per token,    10.13 tokens per second)
1.39.732.172 I slot print_timing: id  3 | task 0 |       total time =   93203.69 ms / 65536 tokens
1.39.732.173 I slot print_timing: id  3 | task 0 |    graphs reused =        318
2026-08-19 22:33:18 [DEBUG]
 1.39.733.721 I slot      release: id  3 | task 0 | stop processing: n_tokens = 65535, truncated = 1

replies.body:
That log actually makes the cause much clearer. The `320` isn't the configured 8192 output limit being reached — it's the amount of output that could fit after the prompt had already consumed almost the entire Ollama context.

`65216 prompt tokens + 320 eval tokens = 65536`, and the final `n_tokens = 65535, truncated = 1` is the strongest indication that Ollama is hitting its 65,536-token context ceiling.

So when you say the prompt shouldn't be anywhere near 65K, I'd check the *serialized request* rather than the visible conversation. With dsh this includes the system prompt, tool definitions, session history, and tool results, not just the text you typed.

The next thing I'd check is the model's `contextWindow` in your dsh `llm-pi-ai` configuration. dsh uses that metadata for its context/compaction handling, so if dsh thinks the model has a larger window than the Ollama server actually has, compaction can happen too late and Ollama will hit its hard 65,536 limit first.

If your Ollama server is intentionally configured for 65,536 context, try declaring the same value for the model in `settings.yaml` and see whether auto-compaction starts before the backend reaches 65,536. If you paste that model's `llm-pi-ai` entry, we can check the exact configuration.

Yep, you're right about my LM Studio server being configured for 65,536 context and also same is reflected in DSH Oddly not reflecting in chat though Side is that surprisingly it managed to run for over 90 minutes since yesterday before hitting the cap. New chats do inherit the lower context size, but not this chat, branching doesn't help either

So trying continue again, somehow it could run a little and the context size got updated but its basically stuck at 100%, no way to salvage the chat unless I use a larger model to compact? Since compacting fails too. Do correct me if I'm wrong

That helps narrow it down further. If both LM Studio and dsh are configured for 65,536, then the mismatch I suspected earlier probably isn't between the configured context-window values.

The interesting part is that the existing conversation still gets stuck at ~65.5K and compaction repeatedly fails, while a new chat apparently inherits the lower context settings correctly.

That makes me wonder whether the context-window value is being captured/cached when the session is created, and changing the model configuration doesn't retroactively update the existing session.

If you can reproduce it, it would be useful to compare the effective `contextWindow`/`max_tokens` values for the old session versus a newly created session using the same model. That could tell us whether this is a stale session configuration issue or something in the compaction path itself.

comments.body:
This is an output-generation ceiling, not necessarily an input context-overflow error. Harness maps the provider stop reason `length` to the durable `max-tokens` turn reason, retains the partial assistant message, and does not dispatch tool calls from that truncated step.

For the llama.cpp trace here, `65,216 prompt + 320 generated = 65,536 total` shows that remaining context headroom is the binding limit. An 8,192 request `maxTokens` cannot fit into the 320 tokens left in the context window. The effective budget is the minimum of the request cap, the provider/model output capability, and `context window - prompt - reserve`.

I wrote a source-linked diagnostic and bounded recovery checklist here: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/output-token-limit.html

The safest recovery is to preserve the partial artifact, start a bounded continuation (for example, only the missing sections), and measure prompt/output usage plus the final stop reason before raising any cap.

This error makes long runs - supposedly a Deepseek Harness strong point - impossible to execute. SIgnificantly I was unable to 'continue' without slamming right back into the same error.
   
Problem: I am getting the same error on long runs: 'Output token limit reachedThe reply was cut off; earlier output is preserved in the conversation. Send "continue" to let the model resume.' 
I am running llama-server locally with model: "unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL" with "--ctx-size 200000". 
That n_ctx conext length limit is clearly shown in the return string from `http://<ip>:<port>/v1/models` in parameter n_ctx but DeepSeek Harness ("DSH") is not triggering a compaction early enough to avoid hitting the limit. 
   
There appear to be two bugs here:
   
1. The first bug is DeepSeek Harness is looking for 'max_tokens', which is not output by llama-server.  llama-server outputs 'n_ctx' to indicate the context window maximum size, for example in response to `http://<ip>:<port>/v1/models`. The fix is for deepseek harness to watch for 'n_ctx' and to respect that limit. Be careful here, because llama-server also outputs 'n_ctx_train' - that is a different parameter, may have a different value, and is not what you want to use. (Openclaw made the mistake of using 'n_ctx_train')
   
2. The second bug appears to be a deliberate design decision. Discovery of the maximum context length is wired only to the "fetch available models" button on the Models page. Nothing calls it at request time. resolveModel() in adapter.ts:256 uses the catalog config, installed catalog, or the default. So even a perfectly fixed readListing() would only pre-fill a form field that you then have to save. If you restart llama-server with a different --ctx-size during a DSH run, the DSH harness never notices. So how do other harnesses handle this? None appear to check n_ctx on every conversational request becasue that is too high an overhead. Instead: 
  
oh-my-pi (issue [#3310](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/3310), closed by PR #3311) probes once at discovery and caches it in SQLite. Restarting the server with a different n_ctx would ignore it for a day. Apparently there is a fix that does the following:
* Read per-model meta.n_ctx from /v1/models, falling back to /props because /props is server-level and llama-swap-style forks give each model its own --ctx-size.
* Lazy re-resolution on model select. Re-query when the user picks a model, since meta.n_ctx only appears once the model is actually loaded (unloaded models show no n_ctx; /props returns n_ctx: 0).
* Fingerprint the cache key on build_info + model_path + n_ctx so a restart invalidates immediately.
   
Openclaw (issue #73664 https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/73664) has the same problem as DSH. It reads the wrong field n_ctx_train rather than n_ctx.
   
OpenHarness (issue #199 https://github.com/HKUDS/OpenHarness/issues/199) has the same problem as DSH. Their fix is to widen the error matcher to catch exceed_context, exceeds the available context size, and exceed_context_size_error, plus a documented env override. 
   
I am not proposing a specific fix for DSH because I am still not up to speed on the design philosophy behind the architecture. It seems bug 1 can be addressed simply using the n_ctx setting during model selection. Bug 1 is essential to fix immediately - it is critical. Bug 2 perhaps needs both the cache fingerprinting and error recovery approaches to be robust during long runs. In particular, the longer the agentic run, the more likely the LLM server will restart with a different n_ctx limit. As agentic harnesses extend into days and weeks long runs, Bug 2 becomes increasingly important to fix.
This might help you all. https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3685

I kept having this problem, I had in Ollama context length 64K, but the DeepSeek harness had the published amount of 256K, whenever it reach to 64K the error appeared (so around the 25% mark) I had to modify the context window in the config and open a new session within the workspace for it to take the 64K value (if I restart the harness it overwrites it to 256K). Have not had the problem again.

replies.body:
That’s a useful data point. It makes the configuration/session mismatch look more likely.

The fact that changing the Harness context window to 64K and starting a new session fixes it suggests the existing conversation may have been created with a different context-window value and continued using that metadata, rather than the current model/provider limit.

It would be interesting to confirm whether restarting the server alone (without creating a new session) also fixes it, or whether the session has to be recreated. If the latter, that would point more strongly to the context configuration being captured/stored at session creation time.

This also fits the earlier 65,535 `n_tokens` case: the model itself wasn't necessarily trying to generate 65K tokens; the request appears to have exhausted the effective context budget after accounting for the prompt/history.

I think the next useful thing to inspect is the serialized request/debug output for the affected session - specifically the effective `context_window` and `max_tokens` values actually sent to the provider.

records.title: Run workflows as managed jobs with progress and cancellation
records.body:
## Problem

The `workflow` tool runs in the foreground and returns only after its worker finishes. While it is running, the parent agent cannot do other work. Cancellation also loses the partial result, and there is no supported way to inspect the active phases or continue from a completed phase.

This is a rough edge for the kind of fan-out work the tool is designed for. A ten-minute research or review workflow should not make the parent session look stuck.

## Proposal

Let a workflow run as a managed job through the existing jobs subsystem.

An optional background mode could return a job id immediately. The existing job tools could then expose status, recent logs, the active phase, completed branches, failures, and the final result. Killing the job should cancel the worker and every child agent, then settle the job once.

Foreground behavior should remain unchanged for callers that want one blocking result.

## How I would implement it

1. Add a workflow job producer that owns the worker and its child agents.
2. Emit structured progress records for phase start, phase completion, agent start, agent completion, log output, and the final result.
3. Store bounded recent output in the job snapshot, with the full durable trace in the session log.
4. Route cancellation through the jobs lifecycle so owner teardown and explicit `job_kill` use the same cleanup path.
5. Persist completed `phase()` outputs as checkpoints. Arbitrary JavaScript stacks cannot be resumed safely, so the first resumable contract should restart only from an explicit phase boundary.

The existing [jobs subsystem](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/jobs.md) already owns most of the lifecycle rules. The workflow package would become a producer instead of inventing another background-task API.

## Acceptance criteria

- Background workflow start returns a job id without blocking the parent turn.
- `job_read` and `job_wait` expose the current phase, branch outcomes, and bounded logs.
- `job_kill` cancels the worker and all live children without duplicate completion notices.
- Session or service teardown waits for cleanup and leaves no orphan children.
- The final background result matches the current foreground result shape.
- Foreground workflow behavior remains compatible.
- A workflow written with explicit `phase()` boundaries can restart from the last completed checkpoint after interruption.

The current behavior is described in the [workflow tool README](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/workflow/tool-workflow/README.md).

第 9 章的工作流章节讨论了这个方向（确定性编排 vs 并行）：https://github.com/Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook/blob/main/docs/09-mcp-subagent-workflow.md

records.title: Authoritative effective model selection for subagents and plugin runtimes
records.body:
## Summary

Third-party DSH plugins that route models (agent distributions, team runtimes, workflow plugins) need an **authoritative seam** to determine the *effective* provider / model / reasoningEffort of a request. This is a question about the ecosystem contract, not a bug report.

## Background

DSH already provides rich seams: `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo` for exact-model capability, `installModelSelection` for composing provider/model/reasoningEffort into an agent's request config, `prepareCall` for validating a call config, and the session log's `request/header` event as the durable record of what was actually sent.

We are building [DSHelm](https://github.com/Altairpaca/dshelm), an independent DSH-native agent distribution, and we wrote a keyless contract test that asserts the full chain:

```
DSHelm resolved policy (provider/model/reasoning)
  → real agent loop + installModelSelection composition
  → session request/header event
  → adapter GenerateOptions (the actual provider I/O)
```

For our own path these four agree (test: `packages/dsh/tests/dsh-request-contract.test.ts`). The question is about **plugin-authored** model routing — e.g. a team runtime that wants per-member models.

## Observations on the ecosystem

- `dsh-agent-teams` (0.1.5) passes per-member `agentOptions: { provider, model }` into `subagents.startContinuable` and uses a `withPending` bridge to make the selection visible while the child materializes. That is a reasonable composition strategy.
- The durable, replayable record of what actually happened is the child session's `request/header` event (and the adapter's `GenerateOptions`).
- There is no documented "effective model resolution" service: `resolveModelInfo` answers capability questions, `prepareCall` validates, but neither is an authority on *which* route a particular child ended up with.

## Questions

1. Is the session `request/header` event the **authoritative evidence** plugin authors should assert against for effective provider/model/reasoningEffort? (That is what we do; we'd like this confirmed as the intended contract.)
2. Is there (or is there a plan for) a public seam that answers "what effective route did this agent/child resolve to" — e.g. a `request/header` read helper, a model-selection snapshot, or a documented invariant?
3. For plugin-authored routing (per-member models, fallback chains), what is the recommended composition point: `agentOptions` on `SubagentStartRequest`, `installModelSelection` in the child setup scope, or both with an explicit precedence?

## Environment

- `dsh --version`: 0.1.0-rc.6
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`: 0.1.0-rc.6, Cordis 4.0.1
- Test evidence: keyless composition (scripted rc.6 adapter), no credentials needed

We encountered this while building DSHelm, an independent open-source agent distribution for DSH (not affiliated with DeepSeek). Happy to turn any of the above into a concrete proposal or test fixture if that helps.

records.title: 使用opencode(zen) 的DeepSeek模型 报「API key is invalid」的快速解决方案
records.body:
现象：我购买的opencode zen（注意不是包月续费的go套餐） 使用opencode自带的 agent 用 DeepSeek 正常，但接入 dhs/harness 后，其他模型都能用，但是DeepSeek 报 API key is invalid。

原理： opencode 和 opencode-go 是 pi-ai 里两条不同的 provider 路由，端点不同：
- opencode → https://opencode.ai/zen/v1（Zen）
- opencode-go → https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1（Go）

方案：
配置 provider 的Base URL的时候 使用 Zen 的https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 即可解决问题

priorAudit.title: Subagent回复放到了排队的消息队列，用户可以修改也可以发送插话，是 BUG还是刻意设计？
priorAudit.primaryRoot: 询问子代理回复进入排队消息队列是 BUG 还是刻意设计，认为与用户消息同队列不合理
priorAudit.solution: 该问题属于 DSH 子代理回复投递语义的确认与澄清。pi2dsh 已忠实映射 followUp 与 steer 的区分，排队消息队列是 DSH 核心对子代理回复的投递策略。建议在 DSH 文档中明确说明子代理完成后回复进入消息队列的设计意图，并评估是否将子代理回复与用户消息队列分离。若需调整，属于 DSH 核心 UI/投递语义变更。
priorAudit.blocker: 子代理回复的排队与插话语义由 DSH 核心会话/消息投递逻辑决定，pi2dsh 仅映射现有行为，无法改变核心队列策略。
priorAudit.evidenceNeeded: DSH E2E 测试：创建多子代理会话，验证子代理完成后回复是否进入消息队列及插话行为，确认与文档描述一致。

records.title: [Feature] Parent session should show subagent live progress cards, and auto-resume after subagent returns (or fails)
records.body:
## Problem

When a session spawns a subagent (via `subagent` / `subagent_fork`), the parent agent has no visibility into the child's live progress. The parent keeps emitting "the subagent is still running, I'll wait" and effectively busy-waits. A human must repeatedly ask "any progress?" to learn anything.

Worse: if the subagent's LLM call fails (e.g. `TRANSPORT` / upstream disconnect), the failure is not delivered back to the parent as a `tool/result`, so the parent never resumes — it just hangs waiting for a result that will never arrive.

## Evidence (from an exported `session-a9a7d3d0`)

- Parent emitted a `subagent` tool call at `turn 6, step 11` and never received a matching `tool/result`.
- The child's last LLM chunk ended with:
  `"finish":{"reason":{"kind":"error","failure":{"message":"terminated","code":"TRANSPORT"}}}`
  then entered `llm/retry`; completion was never signaled back to the parent.
- The human had to manually send "任务进展如何" and "任务完成了吗" to learn whether anything happened.

## Requested capability

1. **Live progress cards for subagents** — show each subagent as a collapsible card in the session view with its current step / latest activity / status (running, awaiting tool, done, failed), without the human opening it manually each time.
2. **Auto-resume on return** — when a subagent finishes (success OR error), deliver its result (or a structured failure state) back to the parent and let the parent turn resume automatically — no manual prompt required.
3. **Failure propagation** — a subagent `TRANSPORT` / `EMPTY_RESPONSE` / `SERVER` / `TIMEOUT` failure must become a visible terminal state on the child card AND be returned to the parent `tool/result` (e.g. as an error result), so the parent can decide to retry or report instead of hanging forever.

## Related — comparison with #1968

They are adjacent but distinct, both under the umbrella of "subagent session observability & collaboration":

| Aspect | #1968 | This request |
|---|---|---|
| Direction | Human → subagent (control) | Subagent → human/parent (visibility) |
| Core pain | Composer can only *queue* input; cannot *steer*/interrupt a running child turn | Parent & human cannot *see* the child's live progress; parent doesn't *resume* when child returns/fails |
| Missing channel | A steer/interrupt channel for subagents | Progress cards + result/failure delivery back to parent |
| Who is blocked | The human trying to redirect a long-running child | The parent agent, hanging on a `subagent` call that never yields a `tool/result` |

In short: #1968 asks "let me talk *into* a subagent", while this asks "let me (and the parent) see *out of* it and continue automatically". Solving one does not solve the other.

records.title: 使用deepseek harness 设计插件安装评审师agent时，出现了死循环
records.body: 原始设定： 目前deepseek harness的插件琳琅满目，但是插件安装面临以下问题： 1. 安全问题，目前插件来自于各个渠道，虽然大多数创作者是真正基于开发热情，但也要防止少数开发者偷偷往插件中放入一些安全性或漏洞性的代码，安装插件前，需要审核一下插件是否符合安全性; 2. 效率问题，有一些插件非常消耗token，或者会让整个开发响应速度变慢，虽然起到了一定修饰或者装饰性作用，但是带来的极端效率降低问题也是需要注意的，需要基于效率给予评判; 3. 重复性问题，虽然从大的方面可能插件的功能是独立的，但是随着插件安装数量增多，可能从小的功能点上重复性较高，这样容易使得整个harness变得臃肿繁乱。 基于以上三个隐患，我需要一个插件安装评审师的Agent，主要流程是：用户提出要安装/更新/升级某个插件 -> Agent从多个角度进行评审和建议 -> 等待用户确认是否安装 -> 如果确认，则安装; 如果不确认，则停止安装。 --- 输入设定，让deepseek harness在创造模式下生成agent，权限给的Workspace Wright，生成过程突然出现死循环，一直在打印同样的内容，而没有自动纠偏，在我的两次强制中断提醒后才恢复 --- 以下是deepseek harness自己的复盘： # 插件安装评审师预设制作复盘（含死循环记录） > 记录 2026-08-17 制作「插件安装评审师」（`plugin-reviewer`）Agent 预设的全过程， > 重点复盘其中一次持续数十轮的死循环：**前因、症状、跳出方法、可复用教训**。 ## 背景与目标 用户诉求：DSH 插件来源多样，安装前需要一位「插件安装评审师」Agent 从三个维度把关： 1. **安全性** — 防少数作者往插件里塞后门/漏洞代码； 2. **效率** — 防高 token 消耗、拖慢响应速度的装饰性插件； 3. **重复性** — 防小功能点与已装插件高度重叠，导致 harness 臃肿。 约定流程：用户提出安装/更新/升级 → Agent 多角度评审并给建议 → **等待用户确认** → 确认才安装，否则停止。 产物路径：`~/.dsh/.agent-presets/plugin-reviewer/`（`agent.cordis.yml` + `preset.yml`）。 ## 正常流程（可复用套路） 1. 加载 `editing-cordis-compositions` 技能，明确预设属于 AGENT-PLANE，服务行必须进 `isolate` realm。 2. 用宿主 `agentPresets` 服务：`copy('standard', 'plugin-reviewer', '名称')` 复制标准预设作为起点 （复制是唯一授权写入方式，且不触发沙箱）。 3. 重写 `preset.yml` 的 name/description。 4. 逐行编辑 `agent.cordis.yml`： - 保留：bash、pwsh、fs、fs-search、jobs、skills、compaction 组（isolate）、ask-user、todo、web(search only)； - 删除：plan mode（会阻止安装动作）、goal、subagents/workflow/ralph（评审是有界单 Agent 交互）； - persona 重写为完整评审流程（三维度 + 确认门 + 硬性规则）。 5. 用 `agentPresets.standingKeyFor(id)` **挂载验证**（失败会点名错误行）。 6. 用户新建会话选该预设即可使用。 > 关键体验：动态 Cordis 插件无法 `require` Node 模块（沙箱），要写文件请 inject `fs` 服务 > 用 `ctx.fs.resolve() + writeText()`。 ## 死循环复盘 ### 症状 为调用 `agentPresets` 服务，我定义了一个动态插件注册 `preset_admin` 工具，然后： 反复执行 **内容几乎相同的 no-op bash 调用**（`echo xxx` 数十轮）， 期待"下一步工具就出现在可调用列表里"，结果工具始终不可直接调用，白白消耗轮次与 token。 ### 前因（为什么会这样） 1. **误读了机制**：技能说"注册工具后它会 become callable on your next step"。 但动态插件通过 `cordis_run` 注册的工具**没有进入当前 Agent 的函数 schema**—— `cordis_inspect_query(Tool.listTools)` 显示它"注册且对请求 Agent 可见"， 但模型侧函数列表（system prompt 固定的那批）并没有它，所以我根本无法以函数调用形式触发它。 2. **验证手段选错**：我一直用"再跑一个 bash 空操作"来试探工具是否出现， 而没有检查**权威证据**（工具目录查询结果其实已经返回了）。 3. **缺少跳出机制**：同一模式连续失败多轮，没有停下来换思路，形成惯性循环。 ### 跳出方法（决定性的一步） 完全抛弃"注册工具 → 调用工具"链路，改为**让插件在激活时直接执行操作**： ```js // cordis_define + cordis_run，apply() 激活即执行，宿主侧无沙箱问题 apply(ctx) { return ctx.agentPresets.copy('standard', 'plugin-reviewer', '插件安装评审师') .then(() => ctx.agentPresets.resolve('plugin-reviewer')) .then((p) => console.log('PRESET_COPIED_TO=' + p.path)) } ``` - 用 `bash`/`read` 直接验证文件系统产物（`~/.dsh/.agent-presets/plugin-reviewer/` 出现即成功）； - 验证挂载用同样的"激活时执行"模式调 `standingKeyFor`，把结果**写到工作区文件**再读回， 拿到明确证据（`MOUNT_OK` + roster 含 `plugin-reviewer:user`）。 ### 教训（可复用） 1. **信任权威查询，不要靠空转试探**：工具是否可调用，看 `cordis_inspect_query` 的返回， 而不是反复调用一个不相干的工具去"等它出现"。 2. **识别死循环信号**：连续 3+ 轮"同样调用、同样结果、无进展"就该停——本轮系统也主动提示了 "repeated tool call detected"。 3. **能力分平面**：宿主服务（`agentPresets` 等）不一定需要"注册模型工具"才能用； **"激活时执行 + 文件系统证据"** 是绕过模型函数列表限制的通用套路。 4. **优先选已经验证过的路径**：`copy()` + `standingKeyFor()` 是技能明示的正规写法， 我一开始绕去自定义工具链路，属于自找复杂度。 ## 审查结论（第二次 review，2026-08-17） 对成品预设复查： - **框架**：所有行都是宿主已装包，无服务行泄出 root realm（compaction 组正确 isolate）， 删除 plan/goal/delegation 与"评审→确认→安装"的有界交互匹配，不引入结构性风险。 - **配置**：persona 覆盖三维度评审、证据要求、确认门、硬性规则； 补充了"安装命令写 profile 目录会触发沙箱审批（第二道确认门）"的预期说明。 - **流程**：review → report → ask_user_question → 确认才 add/up/rm，闭环完整。 - **可修复性**：纯 YAML 文本，随时可改；`standingKeyFor` 复验通过，无不可修复问题。 - **有效性**：评审师具备源码获取（npm pack/git clone）、代码扫描（grep/read）、 信誉调研（web search）、确认交互（ask-user）与安装执行（bash + 沙箱审批）的全部能力。 ## 相关链接 - [[总览]] — Harness 框架 - [[代理类型]] — Agent 选择指南 - [[工具]] — 工具参考

records.title: [Bug] DeepSeek 流式工具调用名称被空分片覆盖，导致 `unknown tool ""`
records.body:
## 问题概述

使用 `deepseek-official` 提供方进行流式工具调用时，第一个工具调用分片会携带正确的函数名称，但后续参数分片可能继续携带空字符串形式的 `function.name`。

当前 DeepSeek 流式响应转换器会用后续的空字符串覆盖已经收到的有效名称，导致最终执行一个名称为空的工具，并报错：

```text
Error: unknown tool ""
```

工具本身已经正确注册，请求中的工具 schema 也包含对应工具，因此问题不在工具注册，而是在 DeepSeek SSE 流式响应转换过程中。

## 运行环境

- DeepSeek Harness：`master`
- Commit：`47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`
- Package version：`0.1.0-rc.5`
- Provider：`deepseek-official`
- Model：`deepseek-v4-flash`
- Node.js：`v22.19.0`
- pnpm：`11.7.0`
- Platform：Windows x64
- 启动命令：

```sh
pnpm dsh web
```

## 复现步骤

1. 使用官方命令启动 Web profile。
2. 使用 `standard` agent preset 创建工作区。
3. 要求模型调用一个已注册工具，例如：

```text
请使用 pwsh 工具执行 Get-Location。
```

4. 检查流式 assistant 事件和最终的工具调用事件。

请求头中包含有效的 `pwsh` 工具 schema，说明工具已经正常注册。

DeepSeek 返回的工具调用流大致如下。

第一个分片包含正确的工具名称：

```json
{
  "index": 0,
  "id": "call_xxx",
  "function": {
    "name": "pwsh",
    "arguments": ""
  }
}
```

后续参数分片可能携带空名称：

```json
{
  "index": 0,
  "function": {
    "name": "",
    "arguments": "{\"command\":"
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "index": 0,
  "function": {
    "name": "",
    "arguments": "\"Get-Location\"}"
  }
}
```

## 实际行为

第一个转换后的分片具有正确名称：

```text
tool-call-delta name="pwsh"
```

但后续空名称会覆盖它：

```text
tool-call-delta name=""
block-end name=""
tool/call name=""
```

最终工具执行失败：

```text
Error: unknown tool ""
```

并行生成多个工具调用时，多个调用也可能同时出现这个问题。

## 预期行为

对于同一个工具调用索引，在已经收到非空工具名称后，后续的空 `function.name` 应当被视为未提供名称，不应清除已经保存的有效名称。

如果整个工具调用流始终没有提供非空名称，则可以继续保留现有的空字符串回退行为。

## 根因分析

问题位于：

```text
packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts
```

当前代码会接受所有非 `undefined` 的名称，包括空字符串：

```ts
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```

当后续参数分片包含 `name: ""` 时，前面已经收到的有效工具名称就会被覆盖。

## 建议修复

只在流式分片携带非空名称时更新工具调用状态：

```diff
- if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
+ const name = call.function?.name
+ if (name !== undefined && name !== '') block.name = name
```

这样可以保留第一个有效名称，同时不改变“整个调用始终未收到有效名称”时的现有回退行为。

## 回归测试

可以调整现有的工具调用参数分片测试，使后续分片包含真实响应中出现的 `name: ""`：

```ts
{ index: 0, function: { name: '', arguments: '{"city"' } }
{ index: 0, function: { name: '', arguments: ': "Paris"}' } }
```

所有工具调用增量和最终组装结果都应继续保留：

```text
name: "get_weather"
```

现有的“始终没有提供 ID 或名称”的防御性测试仍应通过，并继续使用空字符串作为最终回退值。

## 验证结果

应用上述修复后，完成了以下验证：

- DeepSeek 转换器测试：30/30 通过
- TypeScript 类型检查：通过
- Lint：通过
- 中英文文档配对检查：通过
- 文档站构建：通过
- 真实 DeepSeek 工具调用：通过

在真实请求中，所有流式工具调用分片都保留了：

```text
name="pwsh"
```

最终事件为：

```text
tool/call name="pwsh"
```

`Get-Location` 成功执行，工具结果中的 `isError` 为 `false`，日志中没有再出现 `unknown tool`。

## 希望确认的问题

1. 官方 DeepSeek 接口在后续参数分片中返回 `function.name: ""`，是否属于预期的协议格式？
2. 在适配器中将空工具名称视为字段缺失，是否符合项目预期？
3. 如果该修复方案可以接受，我愿意继续提交包含源码修复、回归测试和中英文 README 更新的 PR。

comments.body:
这个问题可以尝试绕开 `dsh-llm-deepseek` 的流式拼接器：让一个自带 transport 的 Pi Provider 负责 OpenAI-compatible SSE，再由 `pi2dsh` 把它注册成 DSH 原生模型 route。现成可试的是 `pi-provider-litellm`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-provider-litellm
export LITELLM_BASE_URL="<你的 OpenAI-compatible 服务根地址>"
export LITELLM_API_KEY="<你的 key>"
# 重启 dsh，再从模型选择器选择该 route
```

我对代码链做了逐段核对：该包通过 Pi 的 `createProvider + openAICompletionsApi` 自己接收 SSE；Pi 按 `tool_calls[].index` 保存同一个调用，并且只有在 `id/name` 为非空值时才更新，所以后续的 `name: ""` 不会覆盖首个有效名称。`pi2dsh` 检测到包带 `streamSimple` 后通过 DSH 的 `llm.registerAdapter` 注册 route，最终的非空 name/id 再进入 DSH 工具执行。

这条链在源码语义上能避开原帖指出的覆盖代码；我没有你的具体 DeepSeek 订阅/端点，尚未替你跑账号级 E2E。你如果愿意试一下，把脱敏后的错误和模型 ID 发到 https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/issues ，我会沿真实端点继续解决。

records.title: [Bug Fix] 通过第三方代理网关接入时，所有工具调用报 unknown tool ""
records.body:
## 现象

通过 **OpenAI 兼容代理网关**（如 OpenCode Go）接入 DeepSeek API 时，DSH 中 **所有工具调用** 均失败，报错：

```
Error: unknown tool ""
```

DSH Web UI 中工具卡片显示 `callId` 和 `name` 均为空字符串。

**直连 `api.deepseek.com` 一切正常。**

## 复现条件

- DSH ≤ 0.1.0-rc.7
- 使用任何 OpenAI 兼容代理网关中转 DeepSeek API
- 模型调用包含 tool_calls 的场景（如 `deepseek-v4-flash` + 工具）

## 根因分析

### 1. OpenAI tool_calls 流式协议

OpenAI SSE 流式 tool_calls 的约定：

| chunk | `id` | `function.name` | `function.arguments` |
|-------|------|-----------------|---------------------|
| 第 1 个 | `"call_xxx"` (真实值) | `"tool_name"` (真实值) | `""` 或 `"{"` |
| 后续 | **不存在** | **不存在** | 增量片段 |

关键点：后续 chunk **只需包含 `arguments` 增量**，`id` 和 `name` 字段应该省略。

### 2. DeepSeek 官方 API vs 代理网关

**DeepSeek 官方 API**（正确行为）— 后续 chunk 省略字段：

```json
{"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"function":{"arguments":"{"}}]}}
```

JavaScript 中访问 `call.id` → `undefined`。

**代理网关**（常见行为）— 反序列化后重新序列化，零值显式输出为 `null`：

```json
{"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":null,"type":"function","function":{"name":null,"arguments":"{"}}]}}
```

JavaScript 中访问 `call.id` → `null`。

> 代理网关通常用 Go / Java / Rust 等强类型语言编写。反序列化 JSON 时，缺失字段被初始化为类型零值（Go: 指针 `nil`、字符串 `""`）。重新序列化时若结构体字段未标记 `omitempty`，零值输出为 `null`。这不违反 OpenAI spec，但会破坏下游"字段不存在即无更新"的隐式假设。

### 3. DSH 的逻辑缺陷

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts` 第 159-160 行：

```typescript
if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```

问题：`null !== undefined` 在 JavaScript 中为 **`true`**。

因此当代理网关发来 `id: null` 时，条件通过，`block.callId` 被从 `"call_xxx"` **覆盖为 `null`**，最终 `closeBlock()` 输出空字符串 `""`，工具查找失败。

### 4. 调用流程图

```
Chunk 1: id="call_xxx", name="write"
  → block.callId = "call_xxx"  ✅
  → block.name   = "write"     ✅

Chunk 2 (代理网关): id=null, name=null
  → null !== undefined → true
  → block.callId = null  ❌ 覆盖了 "call_xxx"
  → block.name   = null  ❌ 覆盖了 "write"

closeBlock():
  → callId: ""   → unknown tool
  → name: ""     → unknown tool
```

## 修复方案

将 `!== undefined`（严格不等式）改为 `!= null`（宽松不等式），同时拦截 `null` 和 `undefined`：

```diff
- if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
- if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
+ if (call.id != null) block.callId = call.id
+ if (call.function?.name != null) block.name = call.function.name
```

### 兼容性

| 场景 | `call.id` 的值 | `!== undefined` | `!= null` | 结果 |
|------|---------------|----------------|-----------|------|
| 第 1 个 chunk (真实值) | `"call_xxx"` | ✅ 赋值 | ✅ 赋值 | 无变化 |
| 后续 chunk — 官方 API (省略) | `undefined` | ✅ 跳过 | ✅ 跳过 | 无变化 |
| 后续 chunk — 代理网关 (null) | `null` | ❌ 赋值 null | ✅ 跳过 | **修复** |

此修复 **完全向后兼容**，不影响直连 DeepSeek 官方 API 的任何行为。

## 验证

测试环境：OpenCode Go 代理 (`https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`) + DeepSeek V4 Flash

- **修复前**：所有工具调用报 `Error: unknown tool ""`（已复现）
- **修复后**：工具调用正常执行，callId 和 name 正确保留（已验证）

## 影响范围

该问题影响所有通过代理网关使用 DSH 的用户。从社区讨论看，已有多人报告此问题。修复仅涉及 `translate.ts` 的两行条件判断，改动极小、风险可控。

---

> 环境信息：DSH 0.1.0-rc.7, macOS, Node.js v22

---

<sub>本文由 [yaoagents.com](https://yaoagents.com) 自动发送 | GitHub: [yaoapp/yao](https://github.com/yaoapp/yao)</sub>

comments.body:
Verified on rc.7 (`99f6f02fec`) — both defects are exactly as you describe, and this completes the picture I'd been building across the earlier reports. This is the **7th report in the "unknown tool ''" wire family** (#1713 → #2090 → #2169 → #2343 → #2540 → #2855), and yours is the first to nail the **assembler-side** root cause — the earlier threads all pointed at `translate.ts`, but the shared `BlockAssembler` was the residual gap.

**1. Your two defects confirm at rc.7 source:**
- `assembler.ts:70` — `partial.toolCallId = chunk.id` unconditional; the `if (chunk.name)` at `:71` proves the author intended the guarded pattern. A `""` (or `null`) id on a continuation delta clobbers the first-captured id.
- `assembler.ts:78-82` + `:100` — `block-end` stores the raw block verbatim and `assemble()` returns `partial.block` **without backfilling** from the accumulated `partial.*`. So even with the id captured correctly, a raw `block-end` carrying `id: ""`/`name: ""` wins. The adapter's authoritative-block path then persists the poisoned block.

**2. Your backfill fix is the correct third layer.** The earlier fixes (translate.ts truthy guards — zoahdev's `!= null` on #2090, lanjie8's commit on #2343/#2540) protect the *delta accumulation*; your `assemble()` backfill protects the *block-end merge*. Both layers are needed: the translate fixes stop the deltas from carrying empty values downstream, but any adapter that emits a raw block-end with empty fields (or a truncation that skips deltas entirely) still poisons the final block through the `partial.block` short-circuit. Your "fully-populated block-end is returned unchanged" invariant is the right safety property.

**3. Cross-thread convergence for the fix.** The family now has a complete two-layer fix blueprint:
- **Layer 1 (translate.ts)**: truthy guards `if (call.id)` / `if (call.function?.name)` — covers `null` AND `""` (zoahdev's `!= null` misses `""`; lanjie8's commit `1e635ed` is translate-only).
- **Layer 2 (assembler.ts)**: `if (chunk.id) partial.toolCallId = chunk.id` at `:70` (mirrors `:71`).
- **Layer 3 (assembler.ts)**: your `assemble()` backfill of name/id/arguments from `partial.*` when the raw block-end is missing them.
- **Regression test**: your minimal repro is ideal — it exercises all three layers and asserts the exact `blocks()` output. Worth adding `null` and `""` variants (both shapes appear across providers).

**4. Session-validation note**: the reason this becomes a *permanent* dead session (not just a dead step) is `packages/core/session/src/index.ts:339-347` — a `tool/result` with empty `callId` is rejected on reload, so a poisoned call + result pair makes the history unloadable (#2169's escalation). Fixing the assembler prevents the poison from being written in the first place.

Worth posting your repro + fix on #2540 (the empty-string thread with the fullest root-cause writeup) so the maintainers get the complete two-layer picture in one place — or I can cross-link. Either way, the family is now fully diagnosed end-to-end.

There is a source-level alternate route that avoids both the affected DeepSeek translator and its empty block-end identity. A transport-owning Pi provider such as `pi-provider-litellm` can parse the OpenAI-compatible stream itself, while `pi2dsh` registers that provider as a native DSH LLM route:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-provider-litellm
export LITELLM_BASE_URL="<your gateway root URL>"
export LITELLM_API_KEY="<your key>"
# restart dsh and select the LiteLLM route
```

I audited the complete source path before suggesting this. `pi-provider-litellm` uses Pi's `createProvider` with `openAICompletionsApi`. Pi accumulates calls by `tool_calls[].index`, appends argument fragments, and only replaces the stored id/name when the incoming value is non-empty. A later `id: ""` or `name: null` therefore cannot erase the first valid identity. `pi2dsh` detects the provider's `streamSimple`, wraps it through `llm.registerAdapter`, and carries the finalized identity into DSH's tool block.

I do not have your gateway deployment or subscription, so this is source-audited rather than an account-level E2E claim. If you try it and still reproduce the failure, please post a redacted stream/error at https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/issues and I will follow the real response shape through the bridge.

records.title: DeepSeek adapter translates empty/null SSE tool-call ids into empty block.callId, breaking session history load and downstream tool_call_id validation
records.body:
# DSH DeepSeek adapter 统一修复诊断(2026-08-17)

> 两份历史补丁说明,并新增 P3/P4/P5/P6 根治性补丁与故障分析。历史文档保留作回溯参考。

---

## 1. 故障现象(两类,同根)

运行 `deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash|pro` 时,DeepSeek API **偶发**在并行 ≥2 个
tool call 的流式 delta 里发空 `id` / `name`(违反 OpenAI"id/name 只在首个 delta 出现"的约定),
甚至**整次调用全程不带 id**。由此产生两类故障:

| 现象 | 触发点 | 报错 |
|---|---|---|
| ① 本轮工具全废,对话推不动 | 流式累积被空串覆盖 / 无 id | `unknown tool ""` → `UNKNOWN_TOOL`;agent-loop 整步拒掉重试 |
| ② 继续对话被上游拒绝 | 会话内出现空 `tool_call_id` | `Duplicate value for 'tool_call_id' of in message[N]` → `INVALID_REQUEST`(上一轮内存里是旧 adapter;新写入仍空 id) |
| ③ 重启后历史无法加载 | 存档里保存了空 `callId` 的 tool/result 事件 | `session event at seq N message must have tool source (internal)`(dsh-session 回放校验拒绝) |

### 时间线(本地时间,2026-08-16 → 08-17)

- 22:41–23:07 `session-d3a71f45` / `fcb10cee` 等**补丁前**会话已出现空 callId 存档
- 23:26 / 23:33 应用原 P1(reasoning_content)、P2(空串守卫)
- 23:47–00:17 验证补丁期间六个会话(2f256497/83e6c5d0/b8c7279b/3c7d3156/13569dbc/79177163)
  写入空 callId → 00:17 / 00:23 重启后 **无法加载**(dsh-session 校验)
- dsh web(00:23 启动)对部分会话做了清理重写(六会话一度 0 坏),但 **live 会话
  2f256497 / 83e6c5d0 / 6d14b4b3 / e7935da8 / b8c7279b 被旧代码持续追加空 callId**,
  修复反复被覆盖

**结论:补丁 P1/P2 不是故障根源,也没有解决它** —— 它们只防"空串覆盖已设的 id",
防不了"API 全程不给 id"。坏数据在补丁前就已产生。

---

## 2. 根因链(两处,都在 bundle,源码 `deepseek-harness` 未动)

```
DeepSeek SSE delta 无 id / 空 id
  └─> adapter translate() 累积 block.callId 为空
        ├─ closeBlock: id = CallId(block.callId ?? "")      → block-end id ""
        └─ tool-call-delta: id = CallId(block.callId ?? "") → delta id ""
  └─> dsh-llm BlockAssembler
        ├─ partial.toolCallId = chunk.id(无条件赋值,空串也覆盖)   ← P4a 修
        └─ assemble 兜底: partial.toolCallId ?? CallId(`call-${index}`)
             ?? 只对 undefined/null 生效,空串 "" 不触发 ← P4b 修
  └─> 最终 assistant 块 id="",工具以空 toolCallId 执行
        ├─ 存盘: tool/result.source.callId="" → 重启校验拒绝(故障③)
        └─ 继续对话: 序列化 tool_call_id="" 重复 → 上游拒绝(故障②)
```

关键细节:
- **block-end 的 block 是权威值**(`assemble()` 优先返回它),所以光改 dsh-llm 的 `??` 兜底救不了
  DeepSeek —— **必须在 adapter 的 closeBlock 之前保证 callId 非空**。
- dsh-llm 是 bundle 形态:runtime 用 `lib/index.js`(内联 BlockAssembler, L673+),`lib/types/assembler.js`
  是同源码的独立文件,两处都要打。

### 2.1 扩展根因:`dsh-llm-pi-ai`(opencode-go / pi-ai 路径)

settings.yaml 的 `llm-pi-ai.providers.opencode-go` 走 `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1` 反代,
该反代同时提供 deepseek-v4-flash / pro 等模型。用户在 GUI 模型选择器里切到这类 deepseek
**走的不是 `dsh-llm-deepseek`(直连 DeepSeek API,需要 `llm-deepseek.providers.deepseek.apiKeyEnv`,
settings 里没配)**,而是 `dsh-llm-pi-ai`,它内部用 `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 通用库。

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `toStreamChunks` 用的是**带 block-end 的 chunk 协议**:
- L511 `toolcall_start` → yield `block-start`
- L526 `toolcall_delta` → yield `tool-call-delta`(携带 `id: CallId(known?.id ?? "")`)
- L537 `toolcall_end` → yield `block-end`(携带 `block: { id: CallId(event.toolCall.id), ... }`)

P4 的 `BlockAssembler.assemble()`(L739)只在 `partial.block` 未设时走兜底:
```js
assemble(partial, index) {
    if (partial.block) return partial.block;  // ← partial.block 一旦被 block-end 填了空 id,直接返回,绕开兜底
    switch (partial.blockType) { ... }
}
```
而 `push()` L713 `partial.block = chunk.block;` 会把 `toolcall_end` 携带的空 id block
**直接覆盖** partial.block。**P4 兜底对 dsh-llm-pi-ai 这条路径完全失效**。

P5 修复:**在源头合成 id**(toStreamChunks 入口生成 per-stream `callSalt`,
toolcall_start/delta/end 三处空 id 都兜底合成 `call-<index>-<callSalt>`),
从源头让 block.id 永不为空,partial.block 永远是非空 brand,assemble() 返回它。

### 2.2 扩展根因:`dsh-llm-deepseek` 的 P3 null 漏洞(OpenCode 反代路径)

settings.yaml 里 `llm-deepseek.baseURL = https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`(孤儿配置,
没 `llm-deepseek.providers` 块),用户切到 deepseek 时 `dsh-llm-deepseek` 通过 OpenCode 反代
拿模型,API key 走环境变量(`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`,settings 未显式配,反代侧校验)。

OpenCode 反代的 SSE delta 里 `tool_calls[].id` 可能是 `null`(而非 undefined 或空字符串)。
**P3 的条件 `call.id === void 0 || call.id === ""` 对 null 全部不成立**:
- `null === void 0` → false
- `null === ""` → false
- 第一个 if 不满足 → 进入 `else if (call.id !== void 0 && call.id !== "")`:
  - `null !== void 0` → true
  - `null !== ""` → true
  - **设置 `block.callId = null`**!

然后 `closeBlock` L213 `id: CallId(block.callId ?? "")`:`??` 对 null 返回 `""` → **block id = ""**!

P6 修复:把 `=== void 0` 改成 `== null`(同时匹配 undefined 和 null),`!== void 0` 改成 `!= null`。
P6 已在 `E:\caches\bun\global\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-llm-deepseek\lib\index.js` L321 落盘,
4 case 验证(`id: null` / 无 id 字段 / 真 id 保留 / null 后真 id 切换)全部产出非空 brand。

---

## 3. 统一补丁(P1-P6,一个脚本全打)

脚本:`patch-dsh-llm-unified.ps1`(幂等,自动跳过已应用项)

| # | 包 | 位置 | 改动 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | dsh-llm-deepseek | serializeAssistant L58 | tool-call 轮恒发 `reasoning_content` | 消除 `INVALID_REQUEST`(无 reasoning 块) |
| P2 | dsh-llm-deepseek | translate delta 累积 | 空串 `id` 不覆盖已设值;`name` 真值守卫(空串/null 均不覆盖,2026-08-17 升级) | 消除 `unknown tool ""` / id 被空串清掉 |
| P3 | dsh-llm-deepseek | translate 开块处 + 流盐 | 当 delta 无 id/空 id 时合成唯一 id `call-<index>-<盐>`,盐每流随机(`callSalt`) | **根治故障②③**(直连 DeepSeek 路径):块 id 永不为空且跨轮不冲突(但漏 null case,P6 修) |
| P4 | dsh-llm | assembler(bundle + types) | `if (chunk.id)` 才赋值;兜底改 `\|\|` 且带随机盐 | 保护所有 provider + 回放路径(delta 累积协议) |
| P5 | dsh-llm-pi-ai | toStreamChunks(block-end 协议) | 入口生成 `callSalt`;toolcall_start/delta/end 三处空 id 都兜底合成 `call-<index>-<盐>` | **修复 P4 兜底被覆盖漏洞**(dsh-llm-pi-ai 是 block-end 协议,partial.block = chunk.block 优先于 assemble 兜底):覆盖 settings 里 `llm-pi-ai.providers.opencode-go` 走 opencode.ai/zen/go/v1 的 deepseek 模型 |
| **P6** | dsh-llm-deepseek | translate L321 条件 | `=== void 0` → `== null`,`!== void 0` → `!= null` | **修复 P3 的 null 漏洞**:OpenCode 反代(走 llm-deepseek)等 SSE delta 里 `tool_calls[].id` 为 `null` 时 P3 漏掉,`null` 进入 else if 设 `block.callId=null`,closeBlock 的 `?? ""` 把 null 当空,产出空 id |

P3 语义(seed 行):
