records.title: 429 with insufficient_quota is classified as terminal QUOTA and never retried, breaking gateway/relay API users
records.body:
Environment: latest checkout, running via `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web`

Problem:
A 429 response whose body contains `code: "insufficient_quota"` / `"Allocated quota exceeded"` is mapped to the terminal code `QUOTA` by `httpErrorCode()` in `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/adapter.ts` (the `isQuotaExceededError` check runs BEFORE the `status === 429` branch). Because `QUOTA` is not in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` in `packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts`, llm-retry skips retrying entirely — a single transient 429 kills the whole turn.

Why it matters:
Many OpenAI-compatible gateways/relays (one-api, new-api, chatanywhere, etc.) return `429 insufficient_quota` for TRANSIENT rate/allowance throttling, not just for truly exhausted balances. For those users every burst of requests fails with no retry, making the harness unusable under rate limits.

Repro:
- Configure a deepseek/openai-compatible provider whose gateway returns 429 + `insufficient_quota` on burst
- Observe session event: failure.code === 'QUOTA', no llm/retry event, turn errors out
- Expected: 429 should follow the RATE_LIMIT retry path (respecting Retry-After), and only genuinely exhausted-balance responses should be terminal

Suggested fix:
1. Add `'QUOTA'` to `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` (worked for us)
2. Or better: in `httpErrorCode`, only classify as QUOTA when it is a 4xx/credit-style exhaustion (e.g. 400/403 semantics), and let `status === 429` take precedence for RATE_LIMIT

comments.body:
Confirmed the mechanism you describe, with one correction to the proposed fix and a primary-source payload that I think changes the shape of the right solution. ## Your root cause is right `httpErrorCode` (`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/adapter.ts`) evaluates the text classifier before it looks at the status: ```ts if (isQuotaExceededError(detail)) return QUOTA_EXCEEDED_CODE if (status === 429) return 'RATE_LIMIT' ``` `classifyPiAiError` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`) has the same order. So a text match outranks a 429, and `QUOTA` is not in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` (`EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `TIMEOUT`, `TRANSPORT`). Relay users get a terminal turn where the upstream meant "come back in a moment". ## Your deployment can be fixed today, without a default change `retryPolicy` is provider config, and `retryableCodes` is part of it, so this is a patch-layer change on your side — no upstream change required: ```yaml # $DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml - id: llm-deepseek config: # an id-targeted patch replaces the entry's whole config — restate your other fields retryPolicy: mode: normal # required by the schema retryableCodes: [EMPTY_RESPONSE, RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT, QUOTA] ``` Verified against `RetryPolicySchema` on rc.7: it resolves to `maxRetries: 2`, backoff `500ms → 10s`, `jitterRatio 0.1`. Omitting `mode` is rejected by the union, which is the one thing easy to get wrong here. ## Why `QUOTA` should not become retryable by default `QUOTA` is a *classification*, not a policy. Other surfaces consume it to tell the user to top up; making it retryable moves every genuinely terminal balance failure to 3 attempts and weakens that signal for everyone in order to fix one deployment shape. The asymmetry also runs the wrong way: an unnecessary retry costs a little latency, while a terminal failure that should have been retried costs the request. Precision belongs in the classifier, not in the retry set. ## Why "400/403 means real exhaustion" cannot work either Terminal exhaustion has no consistent status across providers. From my own instance's session log (rc.7, `deepseek-official`, `deepseek-v4-flash`): ```json {"type":"turn/end","data":{"turn":1,"reason":{"kind":"error", "error":{"message":"Insufficient Balance","code":"QUOTA","status":402}}}} ``` DeepSeek's own hard stop is **402**. Alongside the two other majors: | provider | terminal exhaustion wording | status | |---|---|---| | DeepSeek | `Insufficient Balance` | **402** | | OpenAI | `insufficient_quota` / `You exceeded your current quota…` | **429** | | Anthropic | `Your credit balance is too low to access the API…` | **400** | 402, 429 and 400 all mean "terminal" somewhere, and 429 means both things depending on the body. Two consequences: 1. **`httpErrorCode` has no 402 branch at all** (`grep -rn "\b402\b" packages/llm` → no match). The record above is classified correctly only because the message text happens to match `/\binsufficient[\s_-]+(?:quota|balance|credits?)\b/`; the 402 contributed nothing. A wording change upstream turns it into `HTTP_402`. 2. **Anthropic's wording is missed today** — `credit balance is too low` has the noun but no exhaustion verb, so none of the five patterns fire. ## The classifier also errs in the opposite direction Rate limits are commonly expressed *as quota*. Google-style APIs and OpenAI-compatible relays emit wording like: ``` Quota exceeded for quota metric 'Generate Content API requests per minute' ``` This matches `/\b(?:quota|usage[\s_-]+limit)[\s_-]+(?:exceeded|exhausted|reached)\b/` → `QUOTA` → terminal, never retried. Same bug as yours, opposite direction, and it survives whatever the retry set does. The root problem is that `quota` denotes both an *account balance* and a *rate allowance*, and the five patterns treat them as one thing. Multi-clause detail makes it worse. `detail` is `[code, type, message].join(' ')`, so a single string can carry both readings — `Rate limit exceeded. Your quota resets in one minute.` — and any proximity-based rule that ignores clause boundaries will call that terminal. ## A proximity-only fallback is not enough The obvious repair for the missed wording is a fallback that pairs a quota noun with an exhaustion marker inside a token window. I tried exactly that on rc.7 (window 8, tokens split on `[\s,_-]+`, whole `detail` string) and measured it against a 19-case matrix. It fixes `insufficient account balance` and keeps all seven existing assertions in `service.spec.ts` green, but three cases fail: | detail | expected | proximity-only | |---|---|---| | `Your credit balance is too low to access the API` | terminal | missed (noun present, no exhaustion verb) | | `Rate limit exceeded. Your quota resets in one minute.` | transient | **terminal** — `exceeded` and `quota` are 2 tokens apart *across a sentence boundary* | | `Quota exceeded for quota metric '… requests per minute'` | transient | terminal | The second row is a new failure the fallback introduces, and it is the expensive direction. It survives a negative-case suite made of single-clause strings (`rate limit reached`, `quota resets in one minute`, `context window exceeded`) because each of those lacks one of the two token classes — such negatives verify the rule's definition rather than its risk surface. Clause scoping and a transient veto are what actually contain it. ## Proposed shape Structured signal first, prose last, and bias unknown toward retryable: - **T0** — exact `code`/`type` enums (`insufficient_quota`, `insufficient_balance`, `credit_balance_too_low`, `billing_hard_limit_reached` vs `rate_limit_exceeded`, `overloaded_error`). These are provider-maintained values and deserve exact matching; joining them into one string with free prose discards that precision. - **T1** — unambiguous statuses: **402 → `QUOTA`**. - **T2** — prose, split into wording that *has no transient reading* (`insufficient balance`, `balance exhausted/depleted`, `out of credits`, `balance is too low`, `run out of credits`) and wording that does (`quota exceeded/reached`), where the ambiguous half is vetoed by transient markers in the same clause (`retry`, `try again`, `resets`, `per minute/hour/day`, `RPM/TPM`, `too many requests`, `slow down`, `overloaded`). Clause-scoped, window 4 tokens. Deliberately no status numbers in the veto list, since OpenAI ships terminal `insufficient_quota` on 429. - **T3** — fall through to the status default (429 → `RATE_LIMIT`).
Prose layer, same signature as today (drop-in for isQuotaExceededError) ```ts const HARD_TERMINAL_RE = [ /\binsufficient[\s_-]+(?:quota|balance|credits?|funds?)\b/i, /\b(?:balance|credits?)[\s_-]+(?:exhausted|depleted|drained)\b/i, /\bout[\s_-]+of[\s_-]+(?:credits?|budget)\b/i, /\b(?:balance|credits?|funds?)\b[^.;]{0,24}\bis[\s_-]+too[\s_-]+low\b/i, /\brun(?:s|ning)?[\s_-]+out[\s_-]+of[\s_-]+(?:credits?|quota|balance|funds?)\b/i, /\bno[\s_-]+(?:remaining|available)[\s_-]+(?:credits?|quota|balance|funds?)\b/i, ] const SOFT_TERMINAL_RE = [ /\b(?:quota|usage[\s_-]+limit)[\s_-]+(?:exceeded|exhausted|reached)\b/i, /\bexceed(?:ed|s)?[\s_-]+(?:(?:your|the)[\s_-]+)?(?:current[\s_-]+)?quota\b/i, ] const TRANSIENT_VETO_RE = /\b(?:retry|try[\s_-]+again|resets?|slow[\s_-]+down|too[\s_-]+many[\s_-]+requests|overloaded|per[\s_-]+(?:second|minute|hour|day)|[rt]pm|requests?[\s_-]+per)\b/i export function isQuotaExceededError(detail: string): boolean { return detail.split(/[.;\n!]/).some((clause) => { if (clause.trim() === '') return false if (HARD_TERMINAL_RE.some(re => re.test(clause))) return true // never vetoed if (TRANSIENT_VETO_RE.test(clause)) return false return SOFT_TERMINAL_RE.some(re => re.test(clause)) || coOccursInClause(clause) }) } ``` `coOccursInClause` pairs a quota noun (`quota|balance|credits?|funds?|allowance|budget`) with an exhaustion marker (`insufficient|exhausted|depleted|drained|exceed(ed|s)?`) within 4 tokens of the same clause, which is what catches wording like `insufficient account balance` that the fixed patterns miss. Checked against 19 cases: the 7 assertions currently in `packages/llm/llm/tests/service.spec.ts` are unchanged, plus DeepSeek 402, Anthropic `too low`, `insufficient account balance`, `Insufficient balance, please top up and try again` (hard wording must beat the veto), and the transient set above including `Rate limit exceeded. Your quota resets in one minute.` and the `requests per minute` quota wording.
## Related reports - #3073 — pi-ai adapter misclassifies `401/403` appearing in error *text* as `AUTH` - #1631 — quota exhaustion (403) surfaced with the wrong message - #1127 — classify 401/403 bodies by semantics These four are the same root pattern: provider error semantics inferred from prose. `classifyPiAiError` says so in its own comment — *"we are left pattern-matching terse words here"* — because pi-ai flattens the error to `message` upstream. That path genuinely has only text, so the prose layer has to be precise on its own; the deepseek path, by contrast, already receives `code`, `type` and `status` and currently throws the distinction away by joining them. Happy to break the T0/T1 part out into its own thread if that is easier to act on. Aware that external PRs are not being accepted right now, so this is a proposal rather than a patch. 中文摘要 你定位的顺序问题是对的：`httpErrorCode` 里文本分类跑在 `status === 429` 之前，`classifyPiAiError` 同样如此，而 `QUOTA` 不在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 里。 但两个建议我认为方向不对： 1. **你的场景不需要改默认值。** `retryPolicy.retryableCodes` 本来就是 provider 配置，在自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里把 `QUOTA` 加进去即可（`mode: normal` 是 schema 必填，漏了会被 union 拒绝；我在 rc.7 上验证过）。把 `QUOTA` 加进全局默认，等于让所有真·余额耗尽都变成 3 次尝试，并削弱其它消费方依赖的终态语义——`QUOTA` 是分类，不是策略。 2. **「400/403 表示真耗尽」不成立。** 各家状态码不一致：DeepSeek 是 **402**（我本机 session 日志实录 `{"code":"QUOTA","status":402}`），OpenAI 的 `insufficient_quota` 走 **429**，Anthropic 的 `credit balance is too low` 走 **400**。 顺带两个现存缺陷：`httpErrorCode` **完全没有 402 分支**（上面那条判对纯粹是靠正则匹到了 `insufficient balance` 字符串）；而 `Quota exceeded for quota metric '... requests per minute'` 这类**速率**限制会被判成终态，方向和你的问题正好相反。 建议的形状是分层：`code`/`type` 枚举精确匹配 → 无歧义状态码（402）→ 散文（拆成"无瞬时读法"和"有歧义"两类词表，后者受同子句瞬时标记否决）→ 兜底偏向可重试。

Subject: Re: 429/insufficient_quota misclassification on relay gateways — confirmed + one residual

Hello,

Thank you for the detailed root-cause analysis. It is accurate and we have since implemented the fixes you outlined, with one residual issue for your awareness.

What we confirmed (matching your diagnosis):

httpErrorCode (llm-deepseek) and classifyPiAiError (llm-pi-ai) both ran the prose quota classifier before consulting the HTTP status, so a text match outranked a 429, and QUOTA was not in DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES.
On our relay (token.sensenova.cn, OpenAI-compatible), 429 insufficient_quota with body "Allocated quota exceeded / inference tpm exhausted" was being treated as terminal and never retried.
What we did (deployment-level, no upstream change):

Added QUOTA to the provider's retryableCodes via the profile retryPolicy config, per your recommendation — this survives source upgrades since it lives in ~/.dsh/.
Additionally reordered classifyPiAiError (llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts) so the 429/rate.?limit check runs before the prose quota classifier, matching the fix already applied to the deepseek adapter's httpErrorCode.
With these, insufficient_quota and 429001 (tpm exhausted) now retry and usually recover within a handful of attempts (observed 8–9 retries auto-recovering).

One residual we'd appreciate guidance on:

A 429001 "inference tpm exhausted" occasionally takes longer to recover than our (10-minute-budgeted) retry window, and we saw a single case where the request gave up at 10/10 (60s delays). Since TPM recovery on a shared relay is governed by aggregate usage and is inherently unpredictable, a purely retry-count-based budget cannot guarantee coverage.
We would welcome a Harness feature where quota/TPM errors on relays are "parked" for a long / unbounded graceful wait (resuming the turn when the quota returns) rather than consuming count-limited retries, or any recommended pattern for handling this class of relay throttling.
Happy to assist with testing or provide more session logs if that helps.

Best regards

records.body:
## Problem

For a hand-declared `openai-completions` route pointing at an OpenAI-compatible gateway, `dsh-llm-pi-ai` relies on pi-ai's URL-derived compat detection. An unrecognized gateway URL is treated as a standard OpenAI endpoint, so the adapter sends:

- the system prompt as `role: "developer"`, and
- the output cap as `max_completion_tokens`

Classic OpenAI-compatible gateways reject the first with `400` and may not accept the second. There is currently no configuration surface to correct either: `PiAiCompatProfile` only exposes `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/{catalog.ts,config.ts}`), and the README states the rest of pi-ai's compat surface "stays auto-detected and is deliberately not configurable here".

## Reproduction

Route config (`settings.yaml`, redacted):

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    my-gateway:
      apiKeyEnv: MY_GATEWAY_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: openai
        supportsReasoningEffort: true
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
          contextWindow: 1000000
          maxTokens: 384000
```

First request fails:

```
INVALID_REQUEST: 400 {"error":{"code":"invalid_parameter_error","message":"developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

This is the same gateway family as DashScope compatible-mode, where the community plugin `sologuy/dsh-llm-bailian-kimi` documents the identical blocker (its README: Bailian rejects `role: 'developer'`, and this switch is not exposed by DSH's `PiAiCompatProfile` — "这正是本插件存在的理由").

## Why it matters

pi-ai itself supports both fields: `getCompat()` merges `model.compat.supportsDeveloperRole` / `model.compat.maxTokensField` over the URL-derived detection, and pi's own custom-provider configuration exposes them. dsh's adapter builds the pi-ai model compat from only two of the available fields, so deployments behind private/enterprise gateways cannot correct the detection without writing a full custom adapter plugin.

## Proposal

Add to `PiAiCompatProfile` (route-level default, per-model override, same resolution order as the existing two switches):

- `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`
- `maxTokensField?: 'max_tokens' | 'max_completion_tokens'`

passed through to the constructed pi-ai model compat alongside `thinkingFormat` / `supportsReasoningEffort`. Both remain protocol-gated to `openai-completions` like the existing fields.

## Current workaround

A small custom `LlmAdapter` plugin that owns the route and speaks the gateway dialect directly (this is what we shipped for our deployment). If the fields above land, that plugin retires into a `settings.yaml` section.

records.title: Bug: llm-pi-ai 丢弃 supportsDeveloperRole，SGLang/Qwen 收到 developer role 后返回 400
records.body:
## TL;DR

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-root@0.1.0-rc.7` 的 `llm-pi-ai` 配置 schema 会静默丢弃显式的 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false`。pi-ai 随后按 URL/模型自动推断 reasoning model 支持 `developer` message role；只接受 `system` role 的 SGLang/Qwen OpenAI-compatible endpoint 因此返回 HTTP 400 `Unexpected message role.`。

官方目前不接受外部 PR，下面的 fork 分支仅作为可审阅、可 cherry-pick 的修复与测试证据。

## 环境

- DeepSeek Harness：`0.1.0-rc.7`，上游基线 `99f6f02fecdb7dff40c3fbc9470f5907c29f74ca`
- Provider：自托管 SGLang OpenAI-compatible endpoint
- Model：Qwen reasoning model
- Route protocol：`openai-completions`

没有在报告或分支中提交 endpoint、API key 或本地部署配置。

## 现象

配置希望覆盖自动探测：

```yaml
- id: llm
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      local-qwen:
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: https://example.invalid/v1
        compat:
          supportsDeveloperRole: false
        models:
          - id: qwen-reasoning
            reasoningEfforts:
              off:
              high: high
```

但 rc.7 实际发出的第一条 instruction message 是：

```json
{"role":"developer","content":"..."}
```

SGLang 返回 HTTP 400，底层错误为 `Unexpected message role.`。在 Harness 页面上，该请求还可能表现为 `400 status code (no body)` / `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`，容易被误诊为上下文长度问题。

应用修复后，相同配置和其他参数不变，实际 payload 变为：

```json
{"role":"system","content":"..."}
```

本地 Standard 与 Router Standard 两条真实请求均正常完成。

## 根因

`PiAiCompatProfile` 和 `compatProfile` schema 只暴露了：

- `thinkingFormat`
- `supportsReasoningEffort`

因此配置加载阶段会丢掉 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`。`resolveModelCompat()` 也没有把该字段按 model → route → installed catalog → pi-ai URL detection 的顺序合并。布尔值 `false` 丢失后，pi-ai 只能使用自动推断，并给 reasoning model 发送 `developer` role。

## 修复

修复分支：

- Branch: https://github.com/Anothers/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/pi-ai-developer-role-compat
- Commit: https://github.com/Anothers/deepseek-harness/commit/bab04e4a3e6625979c834f57140c097993c7aa45

改动包括：

1. 在 public config type 与 schema 中加入 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`。
2. 在 route/model compat 解析中逐字段合并该值，model override 优先于 route default。
3. 仍只允许它用于 `openai-completions`，其他 protocol 保持 fail-loud。
4. 增加 schema boundary 测试，固定 `false` 不会被物化过程吞掉。
5. 增加真实 mock HTTP provider 回归测试，断言 reasoning request 的 system prompt 以 `role: system` 发出。
6. 同步英文/中文 README、generated config catalog 与既有 Agent Note。

## 验证

- `llm-pi-ai`：9 个测试文件，218 项全部通过。
- 受影响的 `catalog.ts`、`config.ts`：statements / branches / functions / lines 均为 100%。
- 仓库 pre-push 全量 build + TypeScript typecheck 通过。
- 946 组中英文文档 pairing 检查通过；其余 27 项 doc-sync gates 通过。
- 本地真实 SGLang 请求：修复前 `developer` → 400；修复后 `system` → 成功。

如果维护者认可这个配置边界，可以直接采用或 cherry-pick 上述提交；提交基于当前 rc.7 master，未包含任何本地部署 patch。

在 `deepseek-v4-flash`（推理模式）下，任何包含工具调用的轮次都会失败：最终拼接出的 `tool/call` 中 `name` 为空，执行器报告未知工具，代理重试后只返回空补全。同样的任务在 `glm-5.2` 上可以成功，因此问题出在适配器层，而非模型本身。

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts` 第 159–160 行使用了 `!== undefined` 守卫：

```ts
if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name

comments.body:
这类“首包有 name/id，续包发 null 后覆盖”的问题，现有 Pi Provider 路线在代码上可以避开。可以让 `pi-provider-litellm` 自己处理 OpenAI-compatible SSE，再由 `pi2dsh` 注册为 DSH 原生模型 route：

```sh

export LITELLM_API_KEY="<你的 key>"

我没有你使用的具体推理模型订阅/网关部署，所以先作为源码确认的可试方案提供。若实测仍失败，请把脱敏错误、模型 ID 和端点类型发到 https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/issues ，我会继续按真实响应修。

records.title: 接入火山方舟（Ark, volces.com）报 400：pi-ai 将系统提示词以 developer 角色发出，方舟只接受 system/assistant/user/tool
records.body:
> Ark (volces.com) integration fails with 400 `InvalidParameter`: system prompt is sent with role `developer`, which the Ark gateway rejects

## 环境

- dsh：`0.1.0-rc.7`（当前 npm 最新版）
- 底层 LLM 客户端：`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `0.82.1`（dsh 内置；npm 最新 `0.84.2` 同样存在此问题）
- 接入方式：`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` → `llm-pi-ai.providers` 自定义提供方，协议 `api: openai-completions`

## 现象：本次遇到的每一个错误

配置了两个火山方舟提供方（Agent Plan 与 Coding Plan），模型为 DeepSeek V4（GLM 等声明了 `reasoningEfforts` 的模型同样受影响）：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    ark-agent:
      displayName: Ark Agent
      apiKeyEnv: ARK_AGENT_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/plan/v3
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash
          reasoningEfforts: { off: "", high: high, max: max }
        # ... deepseek-v4-pro 同
    ark-code:
      displayName: Ark Code
      apiKeyEnv: ARK_CODE_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3
      models:
        # 同样声明了 reasoningEfforts
```

### 错误 1：ark-agent（`/api/plan/v3`）

每次调用直接失败：

```
本轮运行失败400: {"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`. Request id: 0217871311856159ee13f605c3786670e0524dbc441cb77696edd","param":"","type":"BadRequest"}
```

### 错误 2：ark-code（`/api/coding/v3`）

完全相同的错误（不同 request id）：

```
本轮运行失败400: {"code":"InvalidParameter","message":"The parameter `messages.role` specified in the request are not valid: invalid value: `developer`, supported values are: `system`, `assistant`, `user`, `tool`. Request id: 02178713365052253d6ccd6c87f6638f3cd2525e8826483913bc8","param":"","type":"BadRequest"}
```

### 最小复现（curl，与 DSH 无直接关系，用于证明端点行为）

两个端点行为一致：

| 请求 role | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `developer` | ❌ 400 `InvalidParameter: invalid value: developer` |
| `system` | ✅ 200，正常返回（deepseek-v4-flash 默认还会输出 `reasoning_content`） |

## 根因与错误代码定位

系统提示词（system prompt）被以 `developer` 角色发送，方舟网关拒绝该角色。完整调用链：

**① `dsh-llm-pi-ai` → `resolveModelReasoning()`（lib/index.js 约 1047–1086 行）**

只要模型声明了 `reasoningEfforts` 且包含非 `off` 档位，就返回 `reasoning: true`：

```js
if (!declared.some(([level]) => level !== "off")) invalid(...);
// ...
return {
    reasoning: true,
    thinkingLevelMap: map
};
```

**② pi-ai → `convertMessages()`（`dist/api/openai-completions.js` 约 785–792 行）**

```js
if (context.systemPrompt) {
    const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole;
    const role = useDeveloperRole ? "developer" : "system";
    params.push({ role: role, content: sanitizeSurrogates(context.systemPrompt) });
}
```

**③ pi-ai → `detectCompat()`（同文件约 1141–1148 行）——根因所在**

```js
const isNonStandard = isNvidia ||
    provider === "cerebras" || baseUrl.includes("cerebras.ai") ||
    provider === "xai" || baseUrl.includes("api.x.ai") ||
    isTogether || baseUrl.includes("chutes.ai") ||
    baseUrl.includes("deepseek.com") ||
    isZai || isMoonshot ||
    provider === "opencode" || baseUrl.includes("opencode.ai") ||
    isCloudflareWorkersAI || isCloudflareAiGateway ||
    isAntLing;
// ...
supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter),
```

`isNonStandard` 名单覆盖了 nvidia/cerebras/xai/together/chutes.ai/deepseek.com/zai/moonshot/opencode.ai/cloudflare/ant-ling，但**没有覆盖 `volces.com`**，于是方舟被默认判定为「支持 developer 角色」。

**④ 配置层面无解**

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `compatProfile` 配置项（lib/index.js 约 1375–1382 行）只开放了 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort`：

```js
const compatProfile = z.object({
    thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
    supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean()
});
```

**没有 `supportsDeveloperRole` 开关**，自定义提供方用户无法通过 settings.yaml 关闭该行为。

② + ③ 两个条件同时成立 → 系统提示词以 `developer` 发出 → 方舟 400。默认的 `opencode-go`（`opencode.ai`）在 `isNonStandard` 名单中 → 使用 `system` → 正常，所以只有方舟端点失败。

## 修复方法（当前可用的本地补丁）

修改 pi-ai 的 `detectCompat()` 返回值，仅关闭方舟的 developer 角色（不动其它兼容位）：

```diff
-        supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter),
+        supportsDeveloperRole: (isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)) && !baseUrl.includes("volces.com"),
```

文件：`node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js`

## 修复结果（已实测验证）

通过 pi-ai 真实 `stream()` 路径（与 DSH 相同的代码路径）+ `onPayload` 抓取实际发出的 wire role，使用本机方舟密钥：

| 场景 | 发出的 role | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| ark-agent `plan/v3`（补丁后） | `system` | ✅ 请求成功，正常回复（含 thinking 块） |
| ark-code `coding/v3`（补丁后） | `system` | ✅ 请求成功，正常回复 |
| 强制 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`（模拟补丁前） | `developer` | ❌ 400，错误信息与最初报错完全一致 |

注意事项：

- 补丁只对新进程生效，运行中的 `dsh web` 需要重启；
- `npm` 重装 / 升级 dsh 后补丁丢失，需重新打；
- 备选思路：把 `volces.com` 加入 `isNonStandard` 也能修复，但会连带把 `supportsStore` 置 false（对方舟无实际影响，不过上文 diff 更保守）。

## 建议上游修复方向

1. pi-ai `detectCompat()` 识别 `volces.com`（或新增 ark 内置 provider），令 `supportsDeveloperRole: false`；
2. 在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `compatProfile` 中开放 `supportsDeveloperRole` 布尔开关，允许自定义提供方按需关闭，无需改代码；
3. 先例：OpenClaw 项目遇到完全相同的故障（OpenAI 兼容后端拒绝 `developer` 角色），已通过强制非原生 OpenAI 端点 `supportsDeveloperRole=false` 修复：
   - issue: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/27037
   - PR: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/29479

## 相关隐患（建议一并处理）

若改用 `openai-responses` 协议接方舟，同样的 developer 角色逻辑依然存在：

- `dist/api/openai-responses-shared.js` 约 92 行：`const role = model.reasoning && compat?.supportsDeveloperRole !== false ? "developer" : "system";`
- `dist/api/openai-responses.js` 约 52 行：`supportsDeveloperRole: model.compat?.supportsDeveloperRole ?? true`

当前 `openai-completions` 配置不受影响，但协议切换时同样会踩坑。

comments.body:
This report isolates an important compatibility boundary. I checked rc.7 (`99f6f02`) and the configuration surface confirms the operator-side gap:

- `reasoningEfforts` makes a hand-declared model reasoning-capable;
- pi-ai selects `developer` only when the model reasons and compatibility says that role is supported;
- the rc.7 Harness profile exposes `thinkingFormat` and `supportsReasoningEffort`, but not `supportsDeveloperRole`.

Those three controls should stay separate. `thinkingFormat` changes the reasoning payload dialect. `supportsReasoningEffort` changes explicit effort support. Neither declares which system-message roles the gateway accepts.

For operators, the decisive evidence bundle is small: exact base URL and protocol, declared reasoning metadata, the outbound first message role, the complete 400 with request ID, and an A/B that changes only `developer` to `system`. Do not include the key or full prompt.

The safest immediate production response is a separately verified compatible route. A non-reasoning compatibility profile can be a bounded fallback if selectable reasoning is not required, but its actual wire role and model behavior must be captured. A direct dependency patch can prove the diagnosis in an isolated installation, but it is erased by reinstall or upgrade and requires a restart.

The durable fix is the one proposed here: expose `supportsDeveloperRole` as an explicit compatibility fact, or add a correct built-in detector, with independent tests for both completions and responses protocols.

I turned the decision path, recovery tradeoffs, and regression matrix into a visual runbook: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/openai-compatible-developer-role.html

Independent community handbook, not an official DeepSeek AI project.
这和 #3372 是同一配置缺口。当前版本已能显式设置 `supportsDeveloperRole:false`；火山方舟 route 应发送 system 而非 developer。升级后以真实请求体和 200 响应为准，不能只看设置页保存成功。

records.title: [Bug Fix] Guard tool call name and id against null stream deltas in llm-deepseek
records.body:
### Problem
When connecting to OpenAI-compatible gateways and proxies (such as OpenCode, LiteLLM, OneAPI, etc.), tool call streaming deltas conform to the standard OpenAI SSE shape where the first chunk specifies `{ name: "tool_name", arguments: "" }`, and subsequent argument chunks send `{ name: null, arguments: "..." }`.

In `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`:
```typescript
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```
Because `null !== undefined` is `true` in JavaScript, the valid tool name captured from chunk 1 was being overwritten by `null` in chunk 2, causing the assembled tool call to have `name: ""` (empty string), leading to runtime `Error: unknown tool ""`.

---

### Solution & Commit
A patch with unit tests has been pushed to the fork:
👉 **Commit:** https://github.com/kolawong/deepseek-harness/commit/1aa1af2571
👉 **Branch:** https://github.com/kolawong/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/llm-deepseek-null-tool-delta

- Checked `typeof call.function?.name === 'string' && call.function.name.length > 0` before updating `block.name`.
- Checked `typeof call.id === 'string' && call.id.length > 0` before updating `block.callId`.
- Added unit test in `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/tests/translate.spec.ts` covering SSE chunks with `{ name: null, id: null }` (31/31 Vitest tests passed).

Please consider cherry-picking this fix into master. Thank you!

records.title: llm-pi-ai 让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关可选思考强度（新增 supportsDeveloperRole 回退 system 角色；参考实现，AI 代写，仅供参考）
records.body:
## 正文 | Body

### 摘要 | Summary

**中文**：我是 DSH 使用者。用自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（如百炼 token plan 的 compatible-mode 端点）时，推理模型**选不了努力程度**：界面上没有档位可选，一旦发起带档位（推理）的请求还会 400。原因：pi-ai 对所有未收录的网关默认按"支持 `developer` 角色"探测，而不少网关只认 `system`。我加了一处小改动：给 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 透传 `supportsDeveloperRole` 兼容开关，让这类网关可以显式声明"不认 `developer`"，思考强度档位即可正常使用。改动由 AI agent 代写，**仅供参考**——我了解官方目前不接受外部 PR，请把它当作讨论素材，欢迎任何批评与建议。

**English**: I'm a DSH user. On custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (e.g. the Bailian token-plan `compatible-mode` endpoint), reasoning models **cannot select a reasoning effort**: no levels are offered, and an effort-carrying (reasoning) request fails with 400. The reason: pi-ai auto-detects every unrecognized gateway as supporting the `developer` role, but many gateways only accept `system`. This small change forwards a `supportsDeveloperRole` compat switch through `dsh-llm-pi-ai`, so such gateways can explicitly declare "no `developer` role" and effort selection works. It was drafted by an AI agent and is **for reference only** — I know external PRs aren't accepted at the moment, so treat it as discussion material. Any feedback is welcome.

### 现象 | Symptoms

**中文**：
- 配置：自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（openai-completions），如 `token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`，推理模型（qwen3.x、deepseek-v4-pro 等）；配置形式与官方指引一致。
- 问题：模型平时可用，但**无法选择思考强度**（effort 档位不出现在选择器里）；显式发起带档位的请求时报 400：`developer is not one of ['system','assistant','user','tool','function']`。

**English**:
- Setup: a custom OpenAI-compatible gateway (`api: openai-completions`), e.g. `token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`, with reasoning models (qwen3.x, deepseek-v4-pro, …), configured the official way.
- Problem: models work in general, but **reasoning effort cannot be selected** (no effort levels in the picker); an explicit effort-carrying request fails with 400: `developer is not one of ['system','assistant','user','tool','function']`.

### 根因（我的理解）| Root cause (as I understand it)

**中文**：
1. pi-ai 的 `detectCompat` 只把少数已知厂商列入"非标准"名单；**所有未收录的 baseURL 一律探测为 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`**（`openai-completions.js`：`isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)`）。
2. 模型一旦推理（reasoning），系统提示就按 `developer` 角色发送（`useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole`）；只认 `system` 的网关（百炼风格）随即 400。
3. `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 只透传 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort`，没有 `supportsDeveloperRole`，配置层无从覆盖探测结果；内置目录的标注又只按 route key 精确匹配，换一个 key 就继承不到。

**English**:
1. pi-ai's `detectCompat` lists only a few known vendors as "non-standard"; **every unrecognized baseURL is detected as `supportsDeveloperRole: true`** (`openai-completions.js`: `isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || (!isNonStandard && !isOpenRouter)`).
2. As soon as a model reasons, the system prompt goes out in the `developer` role (`useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole`); `system`-only gateways (Bailian-style) answer 400.
3. `dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `PiAiCompatProfile` forwards only `thinkingFormat` + `supportsReasoningEffort` — no `supportsDeveloperRole`, so a profile cannot override the detection; and the built-in catalog's flag only applies to its exact route key.

### 参考实现 | Reference implementation

**中文**：
- `PiAiCompatProfile` 新增 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean`，按 模型 → 路由 → 已装 catalog 条目 → pi-ai URL 探测 的顺序解析；schema 接受该布尔开关。
- 配置 `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }` 后：思考强度档位出现在选择器里，请求以 `system` 角色发送，不再 400。
- 测试与文档（中英）一并更新。分支：`fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness` → `feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role`（提交 `78a4dfd4a7`）。
- 验证：vitest 59/59、typecheck 与 lint 全绿；实测百炼推理模型档位可选、请求 200（`developer` → 400 对照）。

**English**:
- Adds `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean` to `PiAiCompatProfile`, resolved model → route → installed catalog entry → pi-ai's URL guess; schema accepts it.
- With `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }`: effort levels appear in the picker and requests go out with the `system` role — no more 400.
- Tests + docs (en/zh) updated. Branch: `fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness` → `feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role` (commit `78a4dfd4a7`).
- Verified: vitest 59/59, typecheck + lint green; live check — Bailian reasoning models offer effort levels and answer 200 (with `developer` → 400 as the control).

### 直接试用 | Try it directly

**中文**：
如果你想直接跑一下这份改动，我维护的 fork 里就是当前状态：
- 分支：`feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role`（提交 `78a4dfd4a7`）
- 仓库：https://github.com/fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness
- 用法：在 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` 的目标网关下加 `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }` 即可。

**English**:
If you'd like to try the change directly, my fork has it live:
- Branch: `feat/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role` (commit `78a4dfd4a7`)
- Repo: https://github.com/fanfan-love-meatmeat/deepseek-harness
- Usage: add `compat: { thinkingFormat: openai, supportsReasoningEffort: true, supportsDeveloperRole: false }` under the target gateway in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`.

### 局限 | Caveats

**中文**：
- 改动由 AI agent 生成，未经维护者评审；命名与暴露面未必符合项目方向。
- 仅针对百炼 compatible-mode 实测过；只认 `system` 的其它自定义网关行为类似但未逐一验证。
- 如果团队有更合适的方案（例如在模型发现阶段探测角色/档位支持），我随时愿意补充用例、调整设计或放弃此方案。

**English**:
- Generated by an AI agent; not reviewed by maintainers — naming and surface may not fit the project's direction.
- Tested only against Bailian's compatible mode; other `system`-only custom gateways should behave the same but aren't individually verified.
- Happy to provide more test cases, adjust the design, or drop it if the team prefers another approach (e.g. probing role/effort support at discovery time).

### 致谢 | Thanks

**中文**：感谢阅读。如有用得上我的地方（补测试、改设计、写文档），随时说一声。

**English**: Thanks for reading. Happy to help with more tests, design changes, or docs if useful.

records.title: pi-ai adapter: third-party "server_error"/overload responses are not classified as SERVER and never retried
records.body:
Environment / 环境
DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.5 (commit 47f943859b, 2026-08-13)
Surface: Web GUI (dsh web), agent run / model request
Provider path: third-party OpenAI-compatible API via pi-ai adapter (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai)
Retry plugin: llm-retry present in base bundle (packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml)

Describe the bug / 问题描述
第三方 provider 过载时返回标准错误体：
Error Code server_error: Our servers are currently overloaded. Please try again later.
DSH 直接显示“本轮运行失败”，一次重试都不发生；默认重试策略本应覆盖这类瞬时故障（SERVER/RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT），每次重试都立刻再次失败。

Steps to reproduce / 复现步骤
配置一个会返回 server_error/overload 文案（文本中无 5xx 数字）的第三方 OpenAI 兼容 provider
发送消息触发上游过载错误
观察：本轮立即失败，会话日志无 llm/retry 事件——完全没有退避重试

Expected / Actual
期望：归类为可重试 SERVER，按默认退避重试 2 次（500ms→10s，10% 抖动）后才失败
实际：首次请求即失败，直接把上游原文展示给用户

Root cause / 根因分析
pi-ai 将捕获异常扁平化为 error.message，丢失原始 Error/cause（stream.ts 已有注释），只能文本分类
classifyPiAiError 只把含 5xx 数字的文案（如 HTTP 500）归为 SERVER；server_error: ... 无数字 → 落入兜底 PI_AI_ERROR
PI_AI_ERROR 不在默认重试码白名单（packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts）→ llm-retry 直接放行 → 本轮以错误终结

Relevant code / 相关位置
packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts（修复点）· packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts · packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts · packages/llm/llm-retry/src/index.ts · packages/extensions/ui-cordis/src/client/locales.ts

comments.body:
Thanks @YangZiCong2503416920 for the report and the original diagnosis.

I reproduced this on master at [`141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534). The reported provider text reaches pi-ai as a flattened `errorMessage`, but `classifyPiAiError()` recognizes numeric 5xx status text and not the explicit `server_error` marker. It therefore falls through to `PI_AI_ERROR`; the normal provider retry policy includes `SERVER` but deliberately excludes that catch-all.

I prepared a narrow patch that:

- maps a case-insensitive, word-bounded `server_error` marker to the existing `SERVER` code;
- preserves the higher-priority authentication, quota, rate-limit, and request-size classifications;
- keeps generic `server` prose and `client_error` in `PI_AI_ERROR`;
- adds the reported wording plus negative lookalikes to the adapter regression suite; and
- documents the classifier and retry-policy boundary in the package README and an Agent Note.

Fork commit: [`736420c68e99ad690f1ccec4a81f00391f3d2825`](https://github.com/GCSimba/deepseek-harness/commit/736420c68e99ad690f1ccec4a81f00391f3d2825)

Branch: [`codex/fix-pi-ai-server-error-classification`](https://github.com/GCSimba/deepseek-harness/tree/codex/fix-pi-ai-server-error-classification)

Validation:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts --coverage --coverage.include='packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts'` — 73/73 tests passed; `stream.ts` reached 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines.
- `pnpm run build` — passed.
- `pnpm run lint` — passed.
- `pnpm run doc-sync` — 27 of 28 checks passed; only the symlink verifier was blocked on this Windows checkout by `EPERM` while inspecting existing repository symlinks.
- Repository commit and pre-push hooks completed successfully.

The patch does not add `PI_AI_ERROR` to the retryable set, change error text or schemas, alter retry limits, or make direct `ctx.llm.stream()` calls multi-attempt. I left it as a fork commit because the project's [contribution guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.zh.md) currently does not accept external pull requests.

AI-assisted repository audit and implementation; I reviewed the source, reproduced the failure, and ran every validation listed above. The commit records `Codex <noreply@openai.com>` as a co-author.

I consolidated this into a source-backed operator runbook: https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/pi-ai-server-error-retry.html

One version-sensitive correction is useful for operators: at rc.8 (`141eb6f`), omitted provider policy resolves to **five retries after the initial request**, not two. The default eligible codes are `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `TIMEOUT`, and `TRANSPORT`, with 500ms–10s bounded exponential backoff and 10% jitter. A textual `server_error` still falls through to `PI_AI_ERROR`, so those defaults never execute.

The guide separates four proofs: upstream transient evidence, ordered adapter classification, the selected route policy, and the durable executor. For one turn/step, `llm/retry` proves scheduling was appended before the wait, while the paired `llm/retry-started` proves another request actually began. A scheduled-only event can mean cancellation or disposal; no events can mean classification, policy, exhaustion, an excessive provider delay, or a direct `ctx.llm.stream()` call.

It also explains why adding the catch-all `PI_AI_ERROR` to `retryableCodes` is unsafe, and pins the narrow word-bounded source fix plus positive, negative, and precedence-collision tests.

Canonical guide: https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/pi-ai-server-error-not-retried.md

comments.body: I checked the rc.8 headless parser. Today there is no per-invocation --thinking max flag: the shipped headless app accepts the task positional and --help. The fresh Agent instead reads the shared agent-default-model selection. Two existing controls are easy to confuse: - reasoningEfforts on a model declares which levels that exact model offers and how they map to wire values. - reasoning on an llm-pi-ai provider profile selects the deployment default, for example reasoning: max. If Web and headless use the same DSH_HOME, a successful Web model-picker selection (including effort) is stored in settings.yaml; the next fresh headless Agent reads that shared default. The effective value should be verified from the durable request header and sanitized wire request, not only from visible thinking text. - GPT 5.6 Luna: `/responses` → `openai-responses`

In DSH rc.8, **Fetch available models** reads ids, optional names, and optional capacity fields from `GET /models`. It does not import a per-model protocol. A custom provider route has one route-level `api`, while its `models` entries cannot each name a different protocol. Adopting the full mixed listing into one route can therefore make only one protocol family work and leave the others looking like credential failures.

A safer setup is three protocol-homogeneous DSH provider routes sharing the same credential reference and Go base prefix. The Messages route must be entered manually because rc.8 intentionally limits network discovery to OpenAI Completions and Responses listings.

The reported account option for models deployed in China is a separate entitlement and data-residency decision. It can change model availability, but it should not be treated as a universal fix for a wrong request path.

Full rc.8 routing examples and evidence matrix: [canonical guide](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook/blob/main/docs/en/troubleshooting/opencode-go-model-routing.md) · [visual map](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/opencode-go-model-routing.html).

Disclosure: I maintain the independent SandBase DeepSeek Harness Handbook.

records.title: 让 skill 稳定生效：重构内建技能目录机制
records.body:
# 让 skill 稳定生效：重构内建技能目录机制

## 问题

DSH 的原生 skill 机制达不到我们对"稳定性"的要求。技能目录目前是以**一次性 user-role 消息**的形式交给模型的：digest 驱动、只在 compaction 后重发，触发规则也很软（"如果任务明显匹配，就调用 skill 工具"）。

实际使用中模型经常在关键时刻不去查这份目录。我们踩到过一个真实案例：一个克隆仓库的任务全程没有查阅项目的工作目录 skill，最后把仓库克隆进了工作区根目录而不是约定目录。我们把这件事定性为 **skill 机制本身的呈现失败**，而不是模型能力问题——一个从未被查阅的 skill，本质上是它没有被呈现好。

## 我们做了一个插件，可以体验

在讨论要不要改原生之前，我们先把方案做成了插件 **`dsh-skill-stabilizer`**，在公版 DSH 上（零源码改动）验证机制是否成立。它走的是公开扩展点（`system-prompt/assemble` 瀑布 + `ctx.skills.snapshot()`）：

- 目录进入 system prompt section，随每步组装重新渲染、位置固定，不随 compaction 消失；
- **触发规则改为强制 + 问责**：任务明确点名 skill 或明显匹配其描述时**必须**使用该 skill，使用前**声明**正在使用；跳过明显匹配的 skill 必须**说明原因**；
- 字节预算（`catalogMaxBytes`，默认 20000）：超预算时等份缩短描述、绝不丢弃名字；
- 过滤内建的 digest 目录消息，模型只看到一份权威目录；
- 加载 skill 后的执行纪律写进目录规则：**加载不是一次性阅读，在 skill 管辖的每个后续决策点回到其内容按指令路由，不覆盖时明说并询问**——这是机制级要求，不让每个 skill 作者各自兜底。

真实会话中的观察：目录稳定出现在 system prompt 中；旧 digest 消息不再出现（至少未观察到重复目录）；加载 skill 后模型能按 skill 探测环境、在多个 LLVM 候选前主动询问。代码在 [mouliangyu/dsh-plugins](https://github.com/mouliangyu/dsh-plugins) 的 `packages/skill-stabilizer`。

> 注意：包尚未发布到 npm，目前通过 `pnpm pack` 打包后用 `dsh plugin --profile web add <path>.tgz` 安装；发布后会补上直接安装命令。

## 为什么不用插件来"取代"

插件方案解决不了**取代**：内建的目录机制（digest 驱动的 user-role 消息）**没有任何配置开关可以关闭**。插件只能叠加（双目录、两套规则冲突）或拦截（依赖内部消息格式，上游一改就碎）。所以我们的结论是：**重构内建机制**才是"单一权威呈现"的干净路径；插件是即时可用的过渡载体，但机制本身值得改。

## 方案：改 DSH 内建机制

把目录注入改造成由 `system-prompt/assemble` 瀑布渲染的 **system-prompt section**，每步重新组装：

- **位置固定**，不随 compaction 消失；
- **强制 + 问责的触发规则**（同上）；
- **字节预算**：等份缩短描述、名字永不丢弃；
- **决策时回读**：作为通用执行纪律写进目录规则（见上）。

已在我们的 fork 上实现并通过测试（PR #1，base: master/rc.8）。

## 成本可控

持续注入的成本在实践中很低。真实目录很小——我们的场景约 7.4 KB（6-7 个用户 skill + 约 17 个项目 skill）。按 20,000 字节预算算，约占 1M token 上下文的 0.5%–1.3%（估算口径：20K 字节 ≈ 5K token 起）。每步重渲染不会放大成本：字节预算封住输入 token，KV cache 复用覆盖计算开销。

## 想听听社区的意见

1. "重构内建机制 vs 插件扩展"——插件已验证可行，但"取代"需要动原生，这个判断社区怎么看？
2. 预算语义：单一全局 `catalogMaxBytes`、每项上限、还是两者结合？默认值多少合适？
3. 硬触发规则 vs 软触发规则——不同模型家族的最佳平衡点？
4. 加载后的"决策时回读"是否应成为通用执行纪律写进机制？
5. [discussion 3541](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3541)——`{{...}}` 插值 bug 迫使我们转义 `{`/`}`；`PromptSection` 的 `raw` 标志是否应先落地？

records.title: 用qwen很慢？
records.body: 用qwen，7.7tok/s 切回ds，81tok/s 又遇到相似问题的吗？

comments.body:
﻿想帮你定位，但还缺几个关键信息：
1. 这个 qwen 是**本地部署**（ollama/vllm 等）还是**云端 API**（阿里云百炼等）？
2. 模型具体是哪个（如 qwen2.5:7b / qwen-max）？如果是本地，用的什么量化、什么显卡/显存？
3. 对比的 81 tok/s 是 DeepSeek 官方 API 吗？

如果 qwen 是本地跑的，7.7 tok/s 在 CPU 推理或小显存下是正常水平；如果是 API 却这么慢，则要看网络和并发配置。贴一下部署方式和 `dsh model` 的输出，我可以帮你进一步排查。

1、qwen3.8-max 云端API（百炼）
2、deepseek官方API
3、我是用harness做了gateway，在本地项目使用其编排功能。用的python sdk

﻿qwen3.8-max 是百炼的 max 档，本来就是"慢但聪明"那类，跟 v4 flash 这种快速档比 tok/s 没啥意义，两个不是一个速度等级。7.7 对 max 档来说算正常水平

想确认是不是 harness 转发拖慢的，最省事的办法是绕开它直连百炼测一次：

```python
import time
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key="<key>", base_url="https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1")
t0 = time.time()
text = ""
for chunk in client.chat.completions.create(
    model="qwen3-8-max",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "写300字短文"}],
    stream=True,
):
    if chunk.choices[0].delta.content:
        text += chunk.choices[0].delta.content
print(len(text) / (time.time() - t0), "字/s")
```

直连也这速度就是模型/百炼的锅；直连快很多再回来查 harness。

还有qwen3 系列默认可能带思考模式，思考不算 tok 但特别费时间，看看有没有传 `enable_thinking: false`。

不能直接用 7.7 vs 81 tok/s 判断 Harness 有性能问题：qwen3.8-max 与 DeepSeek 快速档不是同一速度级别，thinking 也会增加首 token 延迟。正确控制组是同模型、同 prompt、同 reasoning 分别直连百炼和经 Harness，记录 TTFT、tok/s、reasoning/output tokens；只有直连明显更快才查 gateway。

records.title: 网关 finish_reason: network_error 未被重试（根因 + 已测试修复 + 过渡插件）
records.body:
## 问题现象

在 OpenAI 兼容网关（如 OpenCode Zen）后面，turn 会直接硬失败，错误串恒定：

```
Provider finish_reason: network_error
```

网关把自身上游连接的瞬时失败作为流的 `finish_reason` 上报；立即重试几乎总能成功（同类报告见 anomalyco/opencode#41236）。dsh 把该失败归类为不可重试，于是整个 turn 硬失败而不是重试——一次真实会话中，subagent 通道连续 8 次都挂在这个串上。

## 根因

两个 adapter 把线上 `finish_reason` 翻译成错误码，都漏掉了 network 变体：

1. **llm-pi-ai** — pi-ai 0.82 把未知 `finish_reason` 映射为 `stopReason: 'error'`，errorMessage 为 `Provider finish_reason: network_error`（`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `api/openai-completions.js` 的 `mapStopReason`）。随后 `classifyPiAiError`（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`）用 `/\b(?:network|connection|socket|fetch)\b/` 匹配——但 `\b` 在 `k` 与 `_` 之间不成立（下划线是 word 字符），`network_error` 落到 `PI_AI_ERROR`，而它不在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 里。`llm-retry` 放行，turn 失败。
2. **llm-deepseek** — `mapFinishReason`（`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`）把未知 reason 大写化为失败码：`network_error` → `NETWORK_ERROR`，同样不在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`。

## 参照

opencode 在 2026-08-21 修复了同样的网关行为：

- anomalyco/opencode@40282c1 — 可重试正则从 `network error` 扩为 `network[-_\s]error`，覆盖连字符/下划线变体。
- anomalyco/opencode@e0b9e68 — finish-step 事件 `rawFinishReason === "network_error"` 时按失败处理，进入既有重试管线（测试断言第 2 次尝试成功）。

## 修复（已备好，已测试）

由于仓库当前不接受外部 PR，修复已在 fork 分支上完成并充分测试：

https://github.com/fan56/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/network-error-retryable

- `llm-pi-ai`：`classifyPiAiError` 在既有 alternation 之前增加显式的 `/network[-_ ]error/i` 分支，三种拼写都归 `TRANSPORT`。既有匹配（AUTH/quota/429/4xx/5xx/timeout/流截断/ECONN*/terminated/premature close）全部不动。
- `llm-deepseek`：`mapFinishReason` 把 `network_error` / `network-error` 映射为 `{kind:'error', failure:{message:'model stopped: <reason>', code:'TRANSPORT'}}`。

`TRANSPORT` 已在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 中，无需改动 retry policy。

测试：`llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts` 扩展了 transport wording 表；`llm-deepseek/tests/translate.spec.ts` 增加 `mapFinishReason` 用例。`vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai packages/llm/llm-deepseek` → 608 全过；`pnpm run typecheck` → 干净。如果团队愿意合入，我可以随时 rebase/调整。

## 已发布版本的过渡插件

给已发布版本用户的插件（在 `agent/request-error` waterfall 末端重试这类失败，仅当所有下游 listener 都弃权时才行动）：

- 仓库：https://github.com/fan56/dsh-llm-net-retry
- npm：`@aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry@0.1.0`（`dsh plugin --profile tui add @aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry`）

它的 e2e 用真实 agent loop + `llm-pi-ai` `openai-completions` adapter 打一个脚本化网关（前两次请求回 `finish_reason: network_error`），断言第三次完成 turn。基础修复合入后该插件自然无害：它只在整个 waterfall 弃权时行动，且绝不触碰 llm-retry 自身的计数。已在真实 dsh 0.1.0-rc.8 TUI 宿主上验证——见下方更新评论。

## 效果

修复后，网关 `network_error` 在两条 adapter 路径上都归为 `TRANSPORT`，落入默认可重试码，`llm-retry` 以标准有界指数退避自动重试（5 次，500 ms→10 s）。既有 `llm/retry` 事件消费者（TUI）无需任何改动即可展示重试。

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

## Problem

Behind OpenAI-compatible gateways (e.g. OpenCode Zen), a turn fails outright with:

```
Provider finish_reason: network_error
```

The gateway reports its own transient upstream connection failure as the stream's `finish_reason`; retrying immediately usually succeeds (same class of reports as anomalyco/opencode#41236). dsh classifies this failure as non-retryable, so the whole turn hard-fails instead of retrying — in one real session the subagent channel hit this string 8 times in a row.

## Root cause

Two adapters turn the wire `finish_reason` into an error code, and both miss the network variant:

1. **llm-pi-ai** — pi-ai 0.82 maps an unknown `finish_reason` to `stopReason: 'error'` with `errorMessage: 'Provider finish_reason: network_error'` (`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `api/openai-completions.js`, `mapStopReason`). `classifyPiAiError` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`) then tests `/\b(?:network|connection|socket|fetch)\b/` — but `\b` does not hold between `k` and `_` (underscore is a word character), so `network_error` falls through to `PI_AI_ERROR`, which `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` does not include. `llm-retry` passes the failure through and the turn fails.
2. **llm-deepseek** — `mapFinishReason` (`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`) uppercases unknown reasons into the failure code: `network_error` → `NETWORK_ERROR`, also not in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`.

## Reference

opencode hit and fixed the same gateway behavior on 2026-08-21:

- anomalyco/opencode@40282c1 — widen the retryable regex from `network error` to `network[-_\s]error`, covering the hyphen/underscore variants.
- anomalyco/opencode@e0b9e68 — fail the finish-step event when `rawFinishReason === "network_error"` so the existing retry pipeline handles it (test asserts the 2nd attempt succeeds).

## Fix (prepared, tested)

Since the repository does not accept external PRs at the moment, the fix is prepared and fully tested on a fork branch:

https://github.com/fan56/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/network-error-retryable

- `llm-pi-ai`: `classifyPiAiError` gains an explicit `/network[-_ ]error/i` arm ahead of the existing alternation, classifying all three spellings as `TRANSPORT`. The existing matches (AUTH/quota/429/4xx/5xx/timeout/stream-truncation/ECONN*/terminated/premature close) are untouched.
- `llm-deepseek`: `mapFinishReason` maps `network_error`/`network-error` to `{kind:'error', failure:{message:'model stopped: <reason>', code:'TRANSPORT'}}`.

`TRANSPORT` is already in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`, so no retry-policy change is needed.

Tests: transport-wording table extended in `llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts`; `mapFinishReason` cases in `llm-deepseek/tests/translate.spec.ts`. `vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai packages/llm/llm-deepseek` → 608 passed; `pnpm run typecheck` → clean. Happy to rebase/adjust if the team wants to land it.

## Workaround plugin for released versions

A plugin for users on released versions (retries these failures at the end of the `agent/request-error` waterfall, only when every downstream listener declined):

https://github.com/fan56/dsh-llm-net-retry — also on npm as `@aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry@0.1.0` (`dsh plugin --profile tui add @aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry`).

Its e2e drives the real agent loop + `llm-pi-ai` `openai-completions` adapter against a scripted gateway failing the first two requests with `finish_reason: network_error` and asserts the turn completes on the third. The plugin stays harmless once the base fix lands: it only acts when the whole waterfall declined and never touches llm-retry's own counting. Now also validated on a real dsh 0.1.0-rc.8 TUI host — see the update comment below.

## Result

With the fix, a gateway `network_error` classifies as `TRANSPORT` on both adapter paths, falls inside the default retryable codes, and `llm-retry` retries it with the standard bounded exponential backoff (5 attempts, 500 ms→10 s). Existing `llm/retry` event consumers (TUI) surface the retries with no changes.

</details>

records.title: Provider model catalogs are stale for OpenCode Go and OpenRouter
records.body:
Tested with `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2` and the Open Design profile on Linux. The active DSH catalog exposed 16 OpenCode Go models while the authenticated provider `/models` endpoint returned 29. OpenRouter exposed 276 while its public `/models` endpoint returned 420; the static catalog also retained 11 IDs no longer returned live. Updating the nested compatible `@earendil-works/pi-ai` dependency from 0.82.1 to 0.84.2 improved this only partially (19 and 346 respectively).

The root behavior appears intentional but surprising: `dsh-llm-pi-ai` documents `registerModelDiscovery` as UI-only candidate discovery, not an active catalog refresh, so routes with omitted `models` remain pinned to the installed pi-ai snapshot.

A validated local workaround is to materialize the live IDs into each provider profile and explicitly state transport metadata so unknown-to-catalog IDs resolve:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode-go:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY
      api: openai-responses
      baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1
      models:
        # exact live /models IDs
    openrouter:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
      models:
        # exact live /models IDs
```

After applying the exact live snapshots, `dsh --profile open-design --models` reports 29/29 OpenCode Go and 420/420 OpenRouter IDs, including `gpt-5.6-luna`, `qwen3.8-max`, `muse-spark-1.2-contributor`, `google/gemini-3.7-flash`, `stealth/ox-alpha`, and `z-ai/glm-5.3`.

Could DSH offer an opt-in live-catalog policy (with timeout/cache/stale fallback), or a supported refresh/adopt command, for OpenAI-compatible routes? That would retain configuration as the source of truth while avoiding silent catalog drift.
